| `agents/*.py` | the agents. Header comment of each file: OWNER / ROLE / NEEDS / WRITES and the result shapes |

## How the model browses

The model (Qwen via browser-use) decides where to go. Three actions of ours make it fast and exact:

- `read_page(url?, topic?, next_page_link?)`: full text of the page it chose (hidden-but-real content included,
  decoys hidden from people excluded); with `next_page_link` it reads every page of a paged list; with `topic` the
  text is saved as Evidence `"<role>.page"` for the analysts. This is "extract a selected page / paginate a
  model-selected result set" from the rules: the model selects, the helper extracts.
- `record(kind, data, source, note)`: one fact.
- `fill_form(fields, apply_button?, then_click?)`: many fields of a form in one step (bid configurator). Also custom
  toggles without an input (shadow DOM), named by their text; sliders set to 'max' are dragged with real mouse events.
  (browser-use's `evaluate` is off: writing page JavaScript cost whole step budgets.)
- `share_tip(tip)`: a short how-to for the site (a URL pattern that opens results directly, how a record opens); later
  agents on that site get the tips in their hints, so one agent's discovery saves every other agent the search.

`read_page` reads live content by default and preserves URL fragments. Explicit `refresh=false` permits cached
immutable evidence. Failed extractions are retried rather than cached as empty results. The popup guard (`swarm/guard.py`) sweeps the agent's page before every step and every 2 s:
each new kind of dialog / overlay / banner / short error page goes to Clef, then Qwen if needed, once ("click" noise, "fill" an access
gate, "leave" anything an agent works with), and the decision is cached per site for all agents, so a notice that comes
back on every page costs one model call per run. The submitter's guard is careful: clicks on noise without inputs only.
The guard owns every block; explorers never interact with one. It sweeps right before each step AND right before
each page action (`GuardedTools.act`): when it had to clear something that appeared after the model looked, the
action is not executed and the model gets a short note ("not executed: a gate covered the page; look again"), with
its memory intact. Gates: sliders/checkboxes are filled from the cached decision; a gate asking for a typed code
(receipt number drawn in a canvas) is read by Qwen from a screenshot (`read_code`) and filled completely, or not at
all - a continue button is never pressed with a typed field empty (that spent the ERP form 9x in
reh_cabb68e26f532fb8). One gate submission per site at a time (`gate:<host>` lock, tabs share the session). The
background loop clicks noise only, and never while an agent action runs. The sweep before a step waits up to
`SWARM_GUARD_SETTLE_S` for items still being classified. An agent passes a gate itself only if it survives 2 steps.
`report_site_capability present=false` caused by login/gate/error trouble is refused (Clef check), so an access
failure never unassigns a site.
Links that open another page ("accept and continue" in notices, "Ã–ffnen" in download bars) are never clicked: when the
model picks one, the item's single staying button (its x) is used instead; only an error page's retry link may lead
away. Inline gates (a slider to drag to the end, a robot checkbox) are found by their slider and unlocked on every
page; fills that only tick boxes and move sliders are cached like clicks. `read_page` prints list links as `<url>`, so
agents open records and messages by URL instead of clicking through locked or paged lists.

Analysts then ask the model to extract a JSON shape from the saved text (`swarm/extract.py`) and apply the brief's
rules in code (latest dated record wins, withdrawn answers ignored, exact reference, authorised sender, ...).

### Which model does what

| Clef (`swarm/decide.py`: closed choice / yes-no, cheap) | Qwen (`swarm/llm.py`, browser-use: writes text and values) |
| --- | --- |
| guard triage: kind of popup + which button clears it, "leave" for content | every browsing step (navigation, forms, the bid wizard) |
| site-role mapping (one choice per role, kept at confidence >= 0.85) | page extraction to JSON, brief facts, read_visual transcription |
| receipt sanity check in `confirm_submission` (blocks only a clear "no") | follow-up planning (coordinator, thinking on), gate field values |

Every Clef use falls back to Qwen (guard items Clef is unsure about, access gates, unmapped roles) or to the old
behaviour (receipt check) when Clef is missing, slow or not confident, so local runs without Clef work unchanged.

## Contracts (agree before changing)

Evidence kinds: `<role>.page` (data: topic, url, title, pages, text) for saved pages; `record` kinds as the scraper's
goal names them (e.g. `mail.tan`). Results keys and shapes are documented at the top of each agent file.
Done flags: `done.tender`, `done.spec`, `done.erp`, `done.mail_core`, `done.mail`, `requirements_final`, `mail_final`.
Analysts expose `refresh(ctx)` (module level): re-run on the pages saved so far (ERP and mail pages are extracted once
each and cached), so the coordinator can update results after its follow-up jobs.

## Local development

```powershell
atira models proxy                                   # terminal 1
atira scout --env | Out-String | Invoke-Expression   # terminal 2
uv run --no-sync python agent.py                     # whole swarm; dumps .swarm/board.json after each phase
$env:SWARM_DEADLINE_S="1200"                         # optional: simulate the 20-minute clock locally
$env:SWARM_ONLY="MaterialMatcher,BidCalculator"; $env:SWARM_BOARD_IN=".swarm/board.json"
uv run --no-sync python agent.py                     # only these agents, on a saved board (no re-scraping)
uv run --no-sync python -m unittest discover -s tests -q
```
`SWARM_BOARD_IN` is ignored in scored runs. `.swarm/` holds scouting data: git-ignored, never ship it.
Replaying analysts on a saved board: the done flags are in the board, so waits return immediately.

## Time budget (20-minute run)

Collecting/analysing stops `ctx.submit_reserve()` seconds before expiry, then VERIFY/COMPUTE (instant) and SUBMIT,
which stops `FINAL_MARGIN_S` (40 s) before expiry. The reserve is estimated live: (wizard steps + 2.5 steps per
position (3 steps each), minus the steps WizardPrep already did) x max(13 s, measured median browsing step x 1.15) +
TAN lookup + safety, clamped to [390, 600] s (calibrated on sandbox signings: 12-13 s per submitter step). `SWARM_SUBMIT_RESERVE_S` > 0 fixes it. The collect cutoff and every browse's stop mark
follow the live value (re-checked each second / before each step).

## Where the time goes (swarm/timeline.py, scripts/timeline.py)

Spans per agent: `browse.step`, `model.queue` (waiting for a slot), `model.call`, `extract`, `wait.dep` (an agent
waiting for an upstream result), `recovery` (browser checks, hung tabs, failed model attempts), `guard`, `browse.failed`;
counters for repeated work (`reads.repeat`, `browse.retries`, `erp.focused`, `browse.crashed`, ...); milestones (first
page per site, first requirements, first usable bid, each position complete, wizard ready, collect end, submit start,
TAN requested/received, entries checked, accepted submission). The run log gets a `progress` line per minute and five
`TIMELINE` lines at the end (the platform keeps only the log's tail); local runs also write `.swarm/timeline.json`.
`scripts/timeline.py <saved log>` rebuilds a timeline from any run log, old or new.

## Coordination (what no longer waits)

- `BidDrafter` recomputes the bid every 3 s during collection (`results["bid_draft"]`); the submitter falls back to it.
- `compute()` names an open dependency for every omitted position and estimated field (`dependencies`, `unresolved`,
  per-line `fields` status: verified / absent / estimated / missing). The coordinator turns those into gaps too, so a
  condition without a price unit is a gap, not "no gaps". Mail gaps start 30 s after the index pass was analysed; a site
  with follow-ups running takes new, different gaps (max 2 at once per site); an unchanged gap set is re-planned only
  after 45 s.
- ERP: the next job is chosen when a tab is free: focused re-reads of what the calculation misses, then prices/stock of
  materials that already match a position, then searches and the best candidate per requirement, then other
  candidates; candidates of already matched positions last. Extraction runs in the background (the tab moves on).
- Analysts extract each page in its own task (`swarm.extract.start_once`): a new page never waits for a slow batch.
- Price conditions: `reconcile_conditions` merges pages of one record only (same record id, linked page URLs, or a
  single dated condition); conflicting reads become `_conflict` (unpriced, a gap), unrelated fragments stay apart.

## Recovery

- A hung-tab check closes only the caller's tab, unowned tabs and idle owned tabs, never another agent's active tab;
  a healthy browser is not re-checked within 20 s. A hung own tab is renewed in place (main tabs stay main tabs).
- A tab that hangs again on the same browser within 5 min continues in a new tab of another responsive browser.
- A crashed browse returns an unfinished result (its pages are already saved); `browse_until_done` retries with the
  saved topics instead of losing the scraper.
- A collection browse that saved pages and then saves nothing for 10 steps ends (decoys, dead ends); the caller resumes.
- Browsing model calls time out after 35 s (`SWARM_BROWSE_MODEL_TIMEOUT_S`) instead of 55 s.
- The platform ends the run when the binding submission goes through; model calls then answer 401 "finished or
  expired run token". With time left and a TAN requested, that counts as acceptance (no false failure, no retries).
- ERP runs up to 10 jobs at once (`SWARM_ERP_TABS`), spread over the browsers by the scheduler (in an earlier A/B on
  one browser, 6 tabs completed 17 ERP jobs vs 12 with 4 and priced 4 positions vs 1).

## Submission

`WizardPrep` opens the bid wizard in browser 0's main tab near the end of collection (entering nothing); at submit
start the mail main tab logs in and opens the inbox (no search filter); `check_entries` compares the summary page
with the bid in code. `fill_form` prefers a real checkbox/switch over an `<output>` that echoes its text, and finds an
unlabelled checkbox by its neighbouring text (a shadow-DOM confirmation box once cost 3.5 signing minutes).
`RUN_LIMIT_S` (default 1200 s, env `SWARM_RUN_LIMIT_S`, 0 = off): every run plans with at most 20 minutes from process
start, so 2-hour test runs show the timing of a scored run.

## Fair-play rules for everyone (a reviewer reads the package)

- No scenario values anywhere (prices, material numbers, refs, logins, TANs, totals, dates, keys, transaction codes):
  not in prompts, hints, defaults, tests or notes. Tests use invented dummy data. Strategy is fine, values are not.
- The model decides where to go and what matters. Code may parse, page through model-selected results, validate,
  compute, fill forms. No fixed click paths, URL lists, or crawl-everything-then-one-prompt helpers.
- Only the provided CDP browsers; no extra Chromium; no hosts besides the platform and the 4 sites; models via the proxy.
- Do not write comments addressed to the reviewer.

## Robustness settings (learned from the first sandbox runs)

- No screenshots per step (`TextSession`): in the sandbox they stalled every step for 30 s. `read_page` covers canvas text.
- No browser-use loading animation: it loads a logo from an external host the sandbox cannot reach, which left the tab
  "loading" and every navigation in that browser timing out. `RobustSession` also stops a stuck load and retries once.
- Qwen's separate reasoning pass is off and replies are forced to a JSON object (`QwenChat`, `LLM.ask_json`): steps
  went from 10-75 s to a few seconds and the "invalid JSON / prose reply" failures stop.
- Scrapers, ERP items and the submitter retry an agent that stopped early, telling it what is already saved.
- Requirements are published early (as soon as a requirement table page is saved) so the ERP work starts sooner.

## Speed (each browsing step is one model call of ~14 s, most of it queue wait: fewer sequential steps = faster)

- Tab scheduler (`swarm/scheduler.py`): each site's main pass keeps its home browser (tender 0, spec 1, ERP 2, mail 3),
  but every parallel job (ERP jobs, mail topic tabs, the Q&A tab, coordinator follow-ups) leases a tab on whichever
  browser has room: at most `SWARM_TABS_PER_BROWSER` (4) browses per browser, a browser already logged in to the site
  preferred (a cold one counts 2.5 extra), one login per browser and site at a time, released tabs pooled per
  (browser, site) and reused logged in. In reh_06531f76ab5f681e browsers 0 and 1 sat idle from minute 3 while eight ERP
  tabs shared browser 2. The ERP pre-warms 2 tabs on other browsers while the requirements are read, and runs prices
  and stock of a search's first 2 candidates next to their record. Pooled tabs close when collection ends.
- A browser's last page is never closed (a blank page is opened first): Chrome quits with its last page, which took
  browser 0 and the signing with it in reh_06531f76ab5f681e.
- Parallel tabs: the 4-browser limit does not limit tabs. Independent jobs run in tabs of their own (`Tab`,
  `browse_in_tabs`); tabs of one browser share its login cookies (most sites; the webmail asks each tab to log in).
  New tabs open next to the others in the browser's window (`TAB_WINDOWS=1`: a window each) and close when their job
  ends. An agent sees only its own tab and unowned ones (popups), never another agent's tab. Rule: one browse() per
  tab at a time.
- Every agent tab has focus emulation on: only one window/tab has the real focus, and without it typing and
  focus-dependent page scripts silently did nothing in the others.
- Lifecycle events are routed per tab (browser-use's single per-client handler dropped other tabs' load events, so
  each navigation in a second tab waited 3-8 s). A tab's later jobs continue from its current page.
- Flash mode for navigating/extracting agents (default): replies are memory + actions only, with a compact system
  prompt (~0.6k instead of ~5k tokens) and a 2000-token reply cap. The bid submitter keeps full reasoning (`flash=False`).
- Unused browser-use actions (web search, LLM extract, screenshots, file system, uploads) are excluded: smaller schema
  in every prompt, and no wasted steps on them.
- Prompt text (goals, hints, rules, tool descriptions) is written tersely: every word is resent on every step.
- Small jobs instead of big ones: an ERP job per search / material record / prices / stock finishes inside its step
  budget, and materials the search list already rules out are never opened.
- Logs: browser-use's own step logs are off (the platform keeps only the tail of a run's log, and they pushed the
  swarm's lines out); `browse` logs one line per step, and the board is summarised in one line after COLLECT.

## Work split (3 people) and how to iterate on your part

| Person | Agents | Iterate with |
| --- | --- | --- |
| A: tender + spec | `scrape_tender`, `scrape_spec`, `analyze_quantities`, `analyze_requirements` | `SWARM_ONLY=TenderScraper,QuantityAnalyzer` live; analysts on a saved board |
| B: ERP | `scrape_erp` (ErpScraper + its tab workers), `analyze_materials` | `SWARM_ONLY=ErpScraper,MaterialMatcher` on a board that has `requirements` |
| C: mail + shared | `scrape_mail`, `analyze_discount`, `compute_bid`, `submit_bid`, `swarm/*` | analysts/calculator on a saved board; `tests/test_rules.py` |

Loop: run your scraper live once -> it dumps `.swarm/board.json` -> replay your analyst on it as often as needed
(`SWARM_BOARD_IN`) -> check the result keys -> tune the goal/hints (strategy only) or the extraction shape -> repeat.
Then a sandbox test run (`atira test-run .`) to check timing; debug with `atira logs <run>`.

## Open items

- Tune goals/hints per site from test-run logs (`atira` MCP: `run_logs`, `run_llm_calls`, `run_screenshot`).
- Submitter: watch the first real runs closely (wizard order, TAN timing).
- Cost: browser-use sends the goal every step; keep goals short.


## Workflow safeguards and evaluation

Requirements are published as specification pages arrive; ERP keeps accepting new requirements until final analysis.
Mail stops 150 seconds before the submission reserve, and every completed mail/ERP extraction is retained immediately.
At the collection cutoff the orchestrator reconciles completed extractions without another model call.

Model attempts time out after 55 seconds (`SWARM_MODEL_TIMEOUT_S`); browsing and analyst calls share a concurrency
limit of 16. A run has its own monotonic clock. Collection children and guard tasks are cancelled and awaited before
signing. Local runs launch persistent CDP browsers so a resumed wizard keeps its tab and login.

The submitter starts a background TAN lookup and polls it while retaining the portal wizard. A replacement request
explicitly invalidates that lookup. A model `done` result is insufficient: `confirm_submission` must match a quoted
receipt on the tender portal. Missing confirmation produces a failed run rather than a misleading success exit.

Open shadow roots, visible editable controls, PDF/text/ZIP documents, and explicit visual transcription have helper
support. Failed or unverified form fields prevent the helper's continue click. These mechanisms do not guarantee
compatibility with every framework or website. [The review backlog](REVIEW.md) distinguishes fixes from remaining
risks; `scripts/evaluate_navigation.py` runs an opt-in live-model discovery check against two synthetic layouts.

Tender positions and Q&A now publish independently as each extraction completes. Specification pages are cached and
merged in observed order; late Q&A is reapplied to original revision facts. The default submission reserve is eight
minutes. Connection establishment has an eight-second timeout; browsing clients are reused within a job and closed
when it ends. The runtime capability-report tool can invalidate a previously complete site mapping.
"""Your agent's entry point: agent.json runs `uv run --no-sync python agent.py`, in the sandbox and on your machine.

The kit only does the plumbing: run.py reads the run and submits an answer, browsers.py attaches to the run's
browsers, models.py calls the hosted Qwen and Clef. Everything else is yours to build, in `solve` below.
Docs: $API/docs/building-an-agent.md, $API/docs/run-contract.md, and the rules: $API/docs/fair-play.md
"""
import asyncio
import json
import logging
import os
import sys
import threading

from playwright.async_api import async_playwright

import run as contract
from swarm.orchestrator import run_swarm


async def solve(task: dict, playwright, scored: bool) -> dict | None:
    """Runs the swarm (see docs/SWARM.md). Agents live in agents/; the orchestrator runs them phase by phase.

    For an "api" submission the swarm leaves the answer in board.results["answer"]; for a "site" submission the
    submit agent enters it on the website and the result is None.
    """
    return await run_swarm(task, playwright, scored)


async def main() -> int:
    """Ends the process itself (no shutdown of leftover tasks, see _exit_now)."""
    _exit_now(await run_once())


async def run_once() -> int:
    logging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO, format="%(asctime)s %(name)s %(message)s")
    task, token = contract.load_run()
    if token:
        _deadline_watchdog(task)
    sites = ", ".join(f"{site.get('siteId')} {site.get('url')}" for site in task["access"])
    print(f"Run {task.get('run_id') or '(local: the scouting logins, nothing counts)'}; websites: {sites}; "
          f"answer via {task['submission']['kind']}", flush=True)
    try:
        async with async_playwright() as playwright:
            answer = await solve(task, playwright, scored=bool(token))
    except Exception as error:
        logging.getLogger("agent").error("Workflow failed: %s", error)
        return 1
    if answer is None:
        print("Portal submission confirmed; no API answer to post"
              if task["submission"].get("kind") == "site" else "No answer to submit", flush=True)
        return 0
    if not token:
        print("Your answer (locally nothing is submitted):", json.dumps(answer, ensure_ascii=False), flush=True)
        return 0
    status, body = contract.submit_answer(task, token, answer)
    print(f"Answer: HTTP {status} {body[:2000]}", flush=True)
    return 0 if status == 202 else 1


def _exit_now(code: int) -> None:
    """Leave without waiting for leftover tasks, threads or browser connections: run reh_3d75a2747df66520 logged
    "Workflow failed" at 19:20 and then hung in shutdown until it was cancelled at 25:20."""
    logging.shutdown()
    sys.stdout.flush()
    sys.stderr.flush()
    os._exit(code)


def _deadline_watchdog(task: dict) -> None:
    """A thread that ends the process once the run has expired, whatever the event loop is doing."""
    left = contract.seconds_left(task)
    if left != float("inf"):
        timer = threading.Timer(max(left + 5, 1), lambda: (print("run expired: exiting", flush=True), _exit_now(1)))
        timer.daemon = True
        timer.start()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    asyncio.run(main())

"""The blackboard: the one place agents share data. Evidence goes in with its source; results are named values.

Everything is JSON-serialisable so a board can be dumped to `.swarm/` and replayed in local development.
Single event loop, so no locks; `wait_for` lets a downstream agent start as soon as upstream posts.
"""
import asyncio
import json
import time
from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass, field
from pathlib import Path


@dataclass
class Evidence:
    kind: str            # label agreed between producer and consumer, e.g. "tender.position" (see docs/SWARM.md)
    site: str            # siteId the fact came from
    data: dict           # the extracted facts, as found (no interpretation)
    source: str = ""     # URL / document / mail subject: where exactly it was read
    author: str = ""     # agent name
    note: str = ""       # caveats: superseded? withdrawn? timezone? uncertain?
    ts: float = field(default_factory=time.time)


class Blackboard:
    def __init__(self):
        self.evidence: list[Evidence] = []
        self.results: dict = {}      # named outputs: "quantities", "materials", "prices", "bid", "answer", ...
        self.errors: list[dict] = []
        self._changed = asyncio.Condition()

    async def post(self, item: Evidence) -> None:
        async with self._changed:
            self.evidence.append(item)
            self._changed.notify_all()

    def query(self, kind: str | None = None, site: str | None = None, prefix: bool = False) -> list[Evidence]:
        def match(e: Evidence) -> bool:
            if kind is not None and not (e.kind.startswith(kind) if prefix else e.kind == kind):
                return False
            return site is None or e.site == site
        return [e for e in self.evidence if match(e)]

    async def set(self, key: str, value) -> None:
        async with self._changed:
            self.results[key] = value
            self._changed.notify_all()

    def get(self, key: str, default=None):
        return self.results.get(key, default)

    async def wait_for(self, kind: str | None = None, key: str | None = None, timeout: float = 600):
        """Block until evidence of `kind` exists (returns the list) or result `key` is set (returns it)."""
        def ready():
            if key is not None and key in self.results:
                return self.results[key]
            if kind is not None and self.query(kind):
                return self.query(kind)
            return None
        if ready() is not None:
            return ready()
        from swarm import timeline
        with timeline.span("wait.dep", key or kind or ""):
            async with self._changed:
                await asyncio.wait_for(self._changed.wait_for(lambda: ready() is not None), timeout)
        return ready()

    def error(self, agent: str, message: str) -> None:
        self.errors.append({"agent": agent, "error": message, "ts": time.time()})

    def to_json(self) -> dict:
        return {"evidence": [asdict(e) for e in self.evidence], "results": self.results, "errors": self.errors}

    def dump(self, path: Path) -> None:
        path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        path.write_text(json.dumps(self.to_json(), ensure_ascii=False, indent=1, default=str), encoding="utf-8")

    @classmethod
    def load(cls, path: Path) -> "Blackboard":
        raw = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        board = cls()
        board.evidence = [Evidence(**e) for e in raw.get("evidence", [])]
        board.results = raw.get("results", {})
        board.errors = raw.get("errors", [])
        return board
"""Everything an agent gets: the task, the blackboard, the model, the browsers and the clock."""
import asyncio
import os
import time
from dataclasses import dataclass, field

import run as contract
from swarm.blackboard import Blackboard
from swarm.llm import LLM

# Collecting and analysing stop `submit_reserve()` seconds before expiry; the rest belongs to SUBMIT (filling the bid
# form and signing takes several minutes of browser steps). SUBMIT itself stops FINAL_MARGIN_S before expiry.
# signing 4 positions took 466 s in run_7732ba545b50b3a5 and ended 60 s before expiry; a 5th position adds ~90 s.
# SWARM_SUBMIT_RESERVE_S > 0 fixes the reserve; by default it is estimated during the run from the positions to enter
# and the measured pace of browsing steps (see Context.submit_reserve), within [MIN_RESERVE_S, MAX_RESERVE_S].
SUBMIT_RESERVE_S = float(os.environ.get("SWARM_SUBMIT_RESERVE_S", 0)) or 660     # the upper bound / fixed value
FIXED_RESERVE = float(os.environ.get("SWARM_SUBMIT_RESERVE_S", 0)) > 0
# Signing took 3:17 to 8:40+ in eight sandbox runs (2026-10-11); with a 444 s reserve run_53e37fff66cc4cc7 ran out of
# time. Until signing is consistently faster the live estimate may save at most 60 s of the 600 s.
# 540 s left no room for one failure: reh_b81fd39601ed7057 (hung tab) and reh_1ee732ce7f300a45 (one position redone)
# both requested the TAN with 40-104 s left and timed out unsigned.
MIN_RESERVE_S = float(os.environ.get("SWARM_MIN_RESERVE_S", 600))
MAX_RESERVE_S = SUBMIT_RESERVE_S
FINAL_MARGIN_S = 40
# Submission model, in browsing steps: wizard steps independent of the positions (login, tender, wizard start, bidder,
# decision, documents, TAN request/entry, summary, confirmation, receipt), steps per position, and the steps the
# wizard warm-up (agents/submit_bid.WizardPrep) already did. Full-reasoning submitter steps are slower than the
# flash steps measured during collection. TAN lookup runs next to the wizard and costs extra time only at the end.
# run_7b060fa870cea9b6: an entered position took 3 steps (one 6: cascading selects), an omitted one 1 step
BASE_STEPS, STEPS_PER_POSITION, PREP_SAVES_STEPS = 12, 3, 4
# Measured submitter pace vs collection pace: run_56cfdff4ff83d569 36 steps / 470 s (13 s), run_7a11d3a90d55e1ce
# 26 steps / 316 s (12 s, collection median ~11-12 s at the time): full-reasoning steps are only slightly slower.
FULL_REASONING_FACTOR, TAN_S, SAFETY_S = 1.15, 60, 45
MIN_SUBMIT_STEP_S = float(os.environ.get("SWARM_MIN_SUBMIT_STEP_S", 13))   # a submitter step is never assumed faster
# A scored run lasts 20 minutes; test runs may last 2 hours. Every run plans with at most RUN_LIMIT_S from process
# start, so test runs show the timing (and the follow-ups that fit) of a scored run. The run's real expiry still wins
# when it is earlier.
RUN_LIMIT_S = float(os.environ.get("SWARM_RUN_LIMIT_S", 1200))


@dataclass
class Context:
    task: dict
    board: Blackboard
    llm: LLM
    pool: object                      # swarm.browser_pool.BrowserPool (None in unit tests)
    scored: bool = False              # True in a real run (has a run token); False for local scouting
    t0: float = field(default_factory=time.time)
    monotonic_start: float = field(default_factory=time.monotonic)
    _locks: dict = field(default_factory=dict, repr=False)
    shared: dict = field(default_factory=dict, repr=False)   # in-memory objects agents share (queues); never dumped

    @property
    def brief(self) -> str:
        return self.task["brief"]

    def site(self, site_id: str) -> dict:
        """The access entry (siteId, url, credentials) of a website, e.g. ctx.site("erp")."""
        for entry in self.task["access"]:
            if entry.get("siteId") == site_id:
                return entry
        raise KeyError(f"no site {site_id!r}; have {[s.get('siteId') for s in self.task['access']]}")

    @property
    def site_ids(self) -> list[str]:
        return [s.get("siteId") for s in self.task["access"]]

    def seconds_left(self) -> float:
        left = contract.seconds_left(self.task)
        simulated = os.environ.get("SWARM_DEADLINE_S")          # local runs: pretend the run lasts this long
        if left == float("inf") and simulated and not self.scored:
            return float(simulated) - self.elapsed()
        return min(left, RUN_LIMIT_S - self.elapsed()) if RUN_LIMIT_S > 0 else left

    def time_left(self) -> float:
        """Seconds of collecting/analysing left (run clock minus what SUBMIT needs)."""
        return self.seconds_left() - self.submit_reserve()

    def submit_reserve(self) -> float:
        """What SUBMIT needs, from the positions to enter and the measured step pace (fixed when configured)."""
        if FIXED_RESERVE:
            return SUBMIT_RESERVE_S
        from swarm import timeline
        positions = len((self.board.get("tender") or {}).get("positions") or []) or 5
        step = min(30.0, max(6.0, timeline.current().median_step()))
        steps = BASE_STEPS - (PREP_SAVES_STEPS if self.shared.get("wizard_ready") else 0) + STEPS_PER_POSITION * positions
        submit_step = max(MIN_SUBMIT_STEP_S, step * FULL_REASONING_FACTOR)
        estimate = steps * submit_step + TAN_S + SAFETY_S + FINAL_MARGIN_S
        return min(MAX_RESERVE_S, max(MIN_RESERVE_S, estimate))

    def stop_at(self, extra: float = 0.0) -> float:
        """Seconds-left mark at which collection work with `extra` seconds of follow-up analysis must stop."""
        return self.submit_reserve() + extra

    def elapsed(self) -> float:
        return time.monotonic() - self.monotonic_start

    def lock(self, name: str) -> asyncio.Lock:
        """A named lock shared by all agents of this run (e.g. so only one agent resolves the site roles)."""
        return self._locks.setdefault(name, asyncio.Lock())
"""Runs the registered agents phase by phase. Agents of one phase run concurrently; a failing agent never stops others.

Time: COLLECT/ANALYZE are cut off when the useful time is gone (ctx.time_left() <= 0); VERIFY and COMPUTE (plain code,
instant) and SUBMIT always run.
Local dev: SWARM_ONLY=a,b runs only those agents; SWARM_BOARD_IN=.swarm/board.json preloads a saved board (ignored
in scored runs). The board is dumped to .swarm/board.json after every phase.
"""
import asyncio
import importlib
import logging
import os
import pkgutil
from pathlib import Path

import agents as agents_pkg
from swarm import timeline
from swarm.agent import REGISTRY, Agent, Phase
from swarm.blackboard import Blackboard
from swarm.browser_pool import BrowserPool
from swarm.context import FINAL_MARGIN_S, Context
from swarm.llm import LLM
from swarm.scheduler import scheduler

log = logging.getLogger("swarm")
BOARD_DUMP = Path(".swarm/board.json")
TIMELINE_DUMP = Path(".swarm/timeline.json")
PROGRESS_EVERY_S = float(os.environ.get("SWARM_PROGRESS_S", "60"))


def discover() -> list[type[Agent]]:
    """Import every module in agents/ so its @register decorators run."""
    for mod in pkgutil.iter_modules(agents_pkg.__path__):
        importlib.import_module(f"agents.{mod.name}")
    return list(REGISTRY)


def select(classes: list[type[Agent]], only: str | None) -> list[type[Agent]]:
    if not only:
        return classes
    wanted = {n.strip() for n in only.split(",") if n.strip()}
    return [c for c in classes if (c.name or c.__name__) in wanted or c.__name__ in wanted]


# Plain-code phases (cross-checks, the bid arithmetic) take well under a second: they run even when collecting used up
# its time, otherwise the submitter would get no bid at all (it then omits every position).
ALWAYS = (Phase.VERIFY, Phase.COMPUTE, Phase.SUBMIT)
QUICK_BUDGET_S = 30


async def _run_agent(agent: Agent, deadline_bound: bool) -> None:
    timeline.AGENT.set(agent.name)          # every span this agent (and the tasks it starts) records carries its name
    try:
        if deadline_bound and agent.phase not in (Phase.VERIFY, Phase.COMPUTE):
            await _until_collect_ends(agent.ctx, agent.run())
            return
        budget = agent.ctx.time_left() if deadline_bound else agent.ctx.seconds_left() - FINAL_MARGIN_S
        if agent.phase in (Phase.VERIFY, Phase.COMPUTE):
            budget = max(budget, QUICK_BUDGET_S)
        await asyncio.wait_for(agent.run(), timeout=max(1.0, budget))
    except asyncio.TimeoutError:
        agent.ctx.board.error(agent.name, "timed out")
        log.warning("%s timed out", agent.name)
    except Exception as error:
        agent.ctx.board.error(agent.name, f"{type(error).__name__}: {error}")
        log.exception("%s failed", agent.name)


async def _until_collect_ends(ctx, coro) -> None:
    """Run `coro` until it ends or the collect time is used up. The cutoff follows the live submission reserve (it
    moves with the measured pace), so it is re-checked every second rather than fixed when the phase starts."""
    task = asyncio.ensure_future(coro)
    try:
        while not task.done():
            left = ctx.time_left()
            if left <= 0:
                task.cancel()
                await asyncio.gather(task, return_exceptions=True)
                raise asyncio.TimeoutError
            await asyncio.wait({task}, timeout=min(1.0, max(0.05, left)))
        task.result()
    finally:
        if not task.done():
            task.cancel()
            await asyncio.gather(task, return_exceptions=True)


def _position_keys(tender: dict) -> dict:
    try:
        from agents.compute_bid import position_keys
        return {str(p.get("position")): position_keys(tender.get("clarifications") or [], str(p.get("position")))["keys"]
                for p in tender.get("positions") or []}
    except Exception as error:  # noqa: BLE001 - a summary must never fail a run

def board_summary(board: Blackboard) -> dict:
    """A compact view of what the swarm knows (one log line), so a run's log shows it even if early lines are lost."""
    r = board.results
    erp = r.get("erp") or {}
    return {"pages": {k: sum(1 for e in board.evidence if e.kind == f"{k}.page") for k in ("tender", "spec", "erp", "mail")},
            "positions": len((r.get("tender") or {}).get("positions") or []),
            "qa": len((r.get("tender") or {}).get("clarifications") or []),
            "requirements": sorted(r.get("requirements") or {}),
            "materials": {p: (m.get("material"), m.get("reason")) for p, m in (r.get("materials") or {}).items()},
            "erp": {"materials": len(erp.get("materials") or {}), "conditions": len(erp.get("conditions") or []),
                    "stock": sorted(erp.get("stock") or {})},
            "discount": r.get("discount"),
            # which release mails were resolved, and which keys the Q&A gave each position: the two sides that must
            # meet for packaging, commitments, setup pools, project bonus and condition groups
            "mail_topics": {t: sorted(v) if isinstance(v, dict) else v for t, v in (r.get("mail") or {}).items()},
            "position_keys": _position_keys(r.get("tender") or {}),
            "open_gaps": [g.get("id") for g in r.get("gaps") or []],
            "unresolved": (r.get("bid_draft") or {}).get("unresolved"),
            "tips": sum(len(v) for v in (r.get("tips") or {}).values()), "errors": len(board.errors)}


def progress_line(ctx) -> str:
    """One line per minute: clock, coverage of the draft bid, and where the last minute went."""
    tl = timeline.current()
    since = max(0.0, tl.now() - PROGRESS_EVERY_S)
    totals = tl.totals(since)
    cov = (ctx.board.get("bid_draft") or {}).get("coverage") or {}
    pages = "/".join(str(sum(1 for e in ctx.board.evidence if e.kind == f"{k}.page")) for k in ("tender", "spec", "erp", "mail"))

    def t(cat):
        x = totals.get(cat) or {"s": 0, "n": 0}
        return f"{x['s']:.0f}s/{x['n']}"
    return (f"progress {timeline.clock(tl.now())} left {ctx.seconds_left():.0f}s (collect {ctx.time_left():.0f}s, "
            f"reserve {ctx.submit_reserve():.0f}s) pages t/s/e/m {pages} positions {cov.get('priced', 0)}/"
            f"{cov.get('positions', 0)} priced, {cov.get('complete', 0)} complete, {cov.get('unresolved', 0)} open deps"
            f" | last {PROGRESS_EVERY_S:.0f}s: steps {t('browse.step')} queue {t('model.queue')} calls "
            f"{t('model.call')} extract {t('extract')} waits {t('wait.dep')} recovery {t('recovery')} | "
            f"model calls {ctx.llm.calls}")


async def _progress(ctx) -> None:
    while True:
        await asyncio.sleep(PROGRESS_EVERY_S)
        try:
            log.info(progress_line(ctx))
        except Exception as error:  # noqa: BLE001 - reporting must never fail a run
            log.debug("progress line failed: %s", error)


async def run_swarm(task: dict, playwright, scored: bool, env=os.environ):
    board = Blackboard()
    preload = env.get("SWARM_BOARD_IN")
    if preload and not scored:                       # never replay data in a scored run
        board = Blackboard.load(Path(preload))
    ctx = Context(task=task, board=board, llm=LLM(), pool=BrowserPool(playwright), scored=scored)
    tl = timeline.reset(ctx.monotonic_start)
    classes = select(discover(), None if scored else env.get("SWARM_ONLY"))
    from swarm.browser_agent import _CHECKED, _HUNG_AT, _MAIN_TABS, _OWNERS, _OPENERS
    from swarm import guard
    for state in (_MAIN_TABS, _OWNERS, _OPENERS, _CHECKED, _HUNG_AT):
        state.clear()
    guard._DECISIONS.clear()
    guard._PENDING.clear()
    log.info("agents: %s", [c.__name__ for c in classes])
    try:
        await ctx.pool.prepare()
        for phase in Phase:
            agents = [c(ctx) for c in classes if c.phase == phase]
            if not agents:
                continue
            bound = phase != Phase.SUBMIT
            if phase not in ALWAYS and ctx.time_left() <= 0:
                log.warning("skipping phase %s: out of time", phase.name)
                continue
            log.info("phase %s: %s (%.0fs left)", phase.name, [a.name for a in agents], ctx.seconds_left())
            if phase == Phase.SUBMIT:
                timeline.mark("submit start", left=round(ctx.seconds_left()),
                              positions=len(((board.get("bid") or {}).get("answer") or {}).get("positions") or []))
            progress = asyncio.create_task(_progress(ctx))
            background = [asyncio.create_task(_run_agent(a, bound)) for a in agents if a.background]
            try:
                await asyncio.gather(*(_run_agent(a, bound) for a in agents if not a.background))
            finally:
                for running in background + [progress]:
                    running.cancel()
                await asyncio.gather(progress, *background, return_exceptions=True)
            if phase == Phase.COLLECT:
                timeline.mark("collect end", left=round(ctx.seconds_left()))
                tl.log_report()          # the platform ends the process right after the submission: report now too
                await _cancel_background(ctx)
                await scheduler(ctx).close_idle()      # pooled collection tabs: signing gets light browsers
                # Guard classification tasks are collection work too. None may survive into signing.
                pending = list(guard._TASKS)
                for t in pending:
                    t.cancel()
                await asyncio.gather(*pending, return_exceptions=True)
                from agents import analyze_discount, analyze_materials, analyze_quantities, analyze_requirements
                await analyze_quantities.publish(ctx)
                await analyze_requirements.publish(ctx)
                await analyze_discount.publish(ctx)
                await analyze_materials.publish(ctx)
                log.info("board after collect (%.0fs left): %s", ctx.seconds_left(), board_summary(board))
            if not scored:
                board.dump(BOARD_DUMP)
        log.info("model calls: %d tokens: %s errors: %d", ctx.llm.calls, ctx.llm.tokens, len(board.errors))
        if (task.get("submission") or {}).get("kind", "api") != "api":
            receipt = board.get("submission") or {}
            if not receipt.get("accepted"):
                raise RuntimeError("No confirmed portal receipt; the run did not verify submission"
                                   + (f" ({receipt['evidence']})" if receipt.get("evidence") else ""))
            log.info("portal acceptance confirmed: %s %s", receipt.get("reference"), receipt.get("evidence") or receipt.get("quote", ""))
            return None                      # a "site" submission was entered by the submitter agent
        answer = board.get("answer")
        if answer is None:
            raise RuntimeError("No schema-valid API answer was produced")
        return answer
    finally:
        pending = list(guard._TASKS)
        for t in pending:
            t.cancel()
        await asyncio.gather(*pending, return_exceptions=True)
        await _cancel_background(ctx)
        await ctx.pool.close()
        if ctx.llm._client is not None:
            await ctx.llm._client.close()
        try:
            tl.log_report()
            if not scored:
                tl.dump(TIMELINE_DUMP)
        except Exception as error:  # noqa: BLE001 - reporting must never fail a run
            log.debug("timeline report failed: %s", error)


async def _cancel_background(ctx) -> None:
    """Extraction tasks started by analysts in the background (they publish when done) end with collection."""
    tasks = [t for t in ctx.shared.get("background", set()) if not t.done()]
    for t in tasks:
        t.cancel()
    await asyncio.gather(*tasks, return_exceptions=True)
"""Tabs for jobs on any browser: idle browsers take work instead of one site's browser doing it all.

Every site used to own one browser (tender 0, spec 1, ERP 2, mail 3) and ran all its parallel jobs in tabs of that
browser. Tender and spec finish early, so in reh_06531f76ab5f681e two browsers sat idle from minute 3 while eight ERP
tabs shared browser 2 (state-capture timeouts, a hung tab, 17 ERP jobs in 974 s).

`lease(ctx, site_id, prefer=b)` hands out a tab on the least loaded responsive browser, with at most TABS_PER_BROWSER
browses at once per browser (main tabs included). A browser already logged in to the site ("warm") is preferred: a
cold one costs a login, so it counts COLD_COST extra, and only one tab per browser logs in to a site at a time (two
logins in one cookie jar can undo each other). A released tab stays open on its page and goes back to a small pool
per (browser, site): the next job there starts logged in, on the site, without opening a new tab.
"""
import asyncio
import logging
import os
import time
from contextlib import asynccontextmanager

import browsers
from swarm import timeline

log = logging.getLogger("browse")

TABS_PER_BROWSER = int(os.environ.get("SWARM_TABS_PER_BROWSER", "4"))
COLD_COST = 2.5            # a browser that still has to log in to the site counts as this many extra busy tabs
POOL_PER_SITE = 3          # idle tabs kept open per (browser, site)


class TabScheduler:
    def __init__(self):
        self.leased: set = set()                       # tabs handed out and not yet released
        self.warm: set[tuple[int, str]] = set()        # (browser, site id) with a finished job: logged in there
        self.warming: dict[tuple[int, str], int] = {}  # (browser, site id) -> leases still logging in there
        self.idle: dict[tuple[int, str], list] = {}    # (browser, site id) -> released tabs on that site
        self.changed = asyncio.Event()

    @staticmethod
    def browsers() -> int:
        return max(1, len(browsers.cdp_urls()))

    def load(self, browser: int) -> int:
        from swarm.browser_agent import _ACTIVE
        busy = {id(t): t for t in list(_ACTIVE) + list(self.leased)}
        return sum(1 for t in busy.values() if _browser_of(t) == browser)

    def mark_warm(self, browser: int, site_id: str) -> None:
        if site_id:
            self.warm.add((browser, site_id))

    def pick(self, site_id: str, prefer: int | None = None) -> int | None:
        """The browser for a new job on `site_id`, or None when every usable browser is full."""
        from swarm.browser_agent import DEAD_FOR_S, _UNRESPONSIVE
        best, best_score = None, None
        now = time.monotonic()
        for b in range(self.browsers()):
            if now - _UNRESPONSIVE.get(b, -1e9) < DEAD_FOR_S:
                continue
            load = self.load(b)
            if load >= TABS_PER_BROWSER:
                continue
            key = (b, site_id)
            warm = key in self.warm or bool(self.idle.get(key))
            if not warm and self.warming.get(key):
                continue                      # someone is logging in to this site there: wait for it
            score = load + (0 if warm else COLD_COST) - (0.5 if b == prefer else 0)
            if best_score is None or score < best_score:
                best, best_score = b, score
        return best

    async def acquire(self, site_id: str, prefer: int | None = None):
        from swarm.browser_agent import Tab
        while True:
            b = self.pick(site_id, prefer)
            if b is not None:
                break
            self.changed.clear()
            try:                              # loads also change when main-tab browses end: look again each second
                await asyncio.wait_for(self.changed.wait(), 1.0)
            except TimeoutError:
                pass
        key = (b, site_id)
        pooled = self.idle.get(key) or []
        tab = pooled.pop() if pooled else Tab(b)
        if key not in self.warm and not pooled and not tab.used:
            self.warming[key] = self.warming.get(key, 0) + 1
            tab._warming = key
        self.leased.add(tab)
        if b != prefer and prefer is not None:
            timeline.count("tabs.spread")
        return tab

    async def release(self, tab, site_id: str, ok: bool) -> None:
        self.leased.discard(tab)
        key = getattr(tab, "_warming", None)
        if key is not None:
            tab._warming = None
            self.warming[key] = max(0, self.warming.get(key, 0) - 1)
        b = _browser_of(tab)
        reusable = ok and not tab.suspect and tab.replacement is None and tab.target_id is not None
        if ok:
            self.mark_warm(b, site_id)
        pool = self.idle.setdefault((b, site_id), [])
        if reusable and len(pool) < POOL_PER_SITE:
            pool.append(tab)
        else:
            await tab.close()
        self.changed.set()

    @asynccontextmanager
    async def logging_in(self, browser: int, site_id: str):
        """A main tab logging in to `site_id`: no leased tab of that browser logs in to the site meanwhile."""
        key = (browser, site_id)
        self.warming[key] = self.warming.get(key, 0) + 1
        try:
            yield
        finally:
            self.warming[key] = max(0, self.warming.get(key, 0) - 1)
            self.changed.set()

    @asynccontextmanager
    async def lease(self, site_id: str, prefer: int | None = None):
        tab = await self.acquire(site_id, prefer)
        ok = False
        try:
            yield tab
            ok = True
        finally:
            await self.release(tab, site_id, ok)

    async def close_idle(self) -> None:
        """Close the pooled tabs (signing needs light browsers more than warm ERP tabs)."""
        tabs = [t for pool in self.idle.values() for t in pool]
        self.idle.clear()
        await asyncio.gather(*(t.close() for t in tabs), return_exceptions=True)


def _browser_of(tab) -> int:
    while getattr(tab, "replacement", None) is not None:
        tab = tab.replacement
    return tab.browser


def scheduler(ctx) -> TabScheduler:
    return ctx.shared.setdefault("tab_scheduler", TabScheduler())

    class Boom(Agent):

            order.append("collect")
            await self.ctx.board.post(Evidence("k", "erp", {}))

"""Model access for agents: concurrency-limited, usage-counted, JSON-friendly. Qwen by default (hosted, free)."""
import asyncio
import json
import re
import os
import httpx

CALL_TIMEOUT_S = float(os.environ.get("SWARM_MODEL_TIMEOUT_S", "55"))
HTTP_TIMEOUT = httpx.Timeout(CALL_TIMEOUT_S, connect=8, write=15, pool=8)

import models
from openai import APIConnectionError, APIStatusError
from swarm import timeline

# Model slots (team limit: 32 concurrent Qwen calls). Browsing steps take a slot of the total; analysis, planning and
# guard calls also take one of the analysis slots, so extraction can never starve the browsing agents.
MAX_CONCURRENT = int(os.environ.get("SWARM_LLM_CONCURRENCY", "30"))
ANALYSIS_CONCURRENT = int(os.environ.get("SWARM_ANALYSIS_CONCURRENCY", "0")) or max(1, MAX_CONCURRENT // 2)


def parse_json(text: str):
    """The first JSON object/array in a model reply (tolerates ``` fences and chatter)."""
    text = re.sub(r"^```(?:json)?|```$", "", text.strip(), flags=re.M).strip()
    for opener, closer in (("{", "}"), ("[", "]")):
        start, end = text.find(opener), text.rfind(closer)
        if start != -1 and end > start:
            try:
                return json.loads(text[start:end + 1])
            except ValueError:
                continue
    raise ValueError(f"no JSON in model reply: {text[:200]}")


class LLM:
    def __init__(self, max_concurrent: int = MAX_CONCURRENT, analysis_concurrent: int | None = None):
        self._sem = asyncio.Semaphore(max_concurrent)   # team limit is 32 concurrent Qwen calls
        self._analysis_sem = asyncio.Semaphore(analysis_concurrent or
                                               (ANALYSIS_CONCURRENT if max_concurrent == MAX_CONCURRENT
                                                else max(1, max_concurrent // 2)))
        self._client = None
        self.calls = 0
        self.tokens = {"prompt": 0, "completion": 0}

    @property
    def client(self):
        self._client = self._client or models.qwen().with_options(timeout=HTTP_TIMEOUT, max_retries=0)
        return self._client

    async def chat(self, messages: list[dict], *, tools: list[dict] | None = None, model: str = models.QWEN_MODEL,
                   think: bool = False, **kwargs):
        """One chat completion; returns the message (`.content`, `.tool_calls`). `think=True` lets Qwen run its
        separate reasoning pass (slower, more tokens): use it for judgement calls, not for plain extraction."""
        args = dict(model=model, messages=messages, **kwargs)
        args.setdefault("temperature", 0)
        if not think and model == models.QWEN_MODEL:
            args["extra_body"] = {**(args.get("extra_body") or {}), **models.NO_THINKING}
        if tools:
            args["tools"] = tools
        queued = timeline.now()
        async with self._analysis_sem, self._sem:
            timeline.add("model.queue", "analysis", queued)
            # Bound each attempt, including providers that leave a connection open without replying.
            for attempt in range(2):
                started = timeline.now()
                try:
                    async with asyncio.timeout(CALL_TIMEOUT_S):
                        reply = await self.client.chat.completions.create(**args)
                    timeline.add("model.call", "think" if think else "chat", started)
                    break
                except (TimeoutError, models.httpx.TransportError, APIConnectionError) as error:
                    timeline.add("recovery", f"model {type(error).__name__}", started)
                    timeline.count("model.failed")
                    if attempt:
                        raise
                    await asyncio.sleep(0.5)
                except APIStatusError as error:
                    timeline.add("recovery", f"model HTTP {error.status_code}", started)
                    timeline.count("model.failed")
                    if attempt or (error.status_code < 500 and error.status_code != 429):
                        raise
                    await asyncio.sleep(0.5)
        self.calls += 1
        if reply.usage:
            self.tokens["prompt"] += reply.usage.prompt_tokens or 0
            self.tokens["completion"] += reply.usage.completion_tokens or 0
        return reply.choices[0].message

    async def ask(self, system: str, user: str, **kwargs) -> str:
        message = await self.chat([{"role": "system", "content": system}, {"role": "user", "content": user}], **kwargs)
        return message.content or ""

    async def ask_json(self, system: str, user: str, retries: int = 1, **kwargs):
        """Ask for JSON; re-ask once with the parse error if the reply is not valid."""
        messages = [{"role": "system", "content": system}, {"role": "user", "content": user}]
        kwargs.setdefault("response_format", {"type": "json_object"})    # Qwen then always answers with JSON
        for _ in range(retries + 1):
            reply = (await self.chat(messages, **kwargs)).content or ""
            try:
                return parse_json(reply)
            except ValueError as error:
                messages += [{"role": "assistant", "content": reply},
                             {"role": "user", "content": f"Invalid: {error}. Reply with valid JSON only."}]
        raise ValueError("model did not return valid JSON")
"""Where a run's time goes: spans (useful work, waits, recovery, model queue, extraction) and milestones.

The platform keeps only the tail of a run's log, so the timeline logs compact lines: a progress line per minute during
collection, one line per milestone, and a short report at the end (category totals, slowest spans, repeated work, time
to first usable bid / complete positions / accepted submission). Locally the full span list is written to `.swarm/`.

    with timeline.span("wait.dep", "requirements"):      # who: the running agent (context variable)
        ...
    timeline.mark("first usable bid", positions=2)       # milestone, first occurrence only
    timeline.count("reads.repeat")                        # repeated work

Categories:
  browse.step     one browsing step (model reply + action + page state): the useful browser work
  model.queue     waiting for a free model slot (our concurrency limit)
  model.call      model latency (analysis, planning, guard; browsing steps contain their own call)
  extract         saved page -> facts (model extraction)
  wait.dep        an agent waiting for an upstream result
  recovery        browser checks, hung tabs, reattaching, retries after failures
  guard           popup sweeps before a step
  browse.failed   whole browses that ended without success (repeated later)
"""
import contextlib
import contextvars
import json
import logging
import time
from collections import defaultdict
from pathlib import Path

log = logging.getLogger("timeline")

AGENT: contextvars.ContextVar[str] = contextvars.ContextVar("swarm_agent", default="-")


def who() -> str:
    return AGENT.get()


class Timeline:
    def __init__(self, start: float | None = None):
        self.start = time.monotonic() if start is None else start
        self.spans: list[tuple[str, str, str, float, float]] = []   # category, agent, label, start, end (run clock)
        self.milestones: dict[str, tuple[float, dict]] = {}
        self.counters: dict[str, int] = defaultdict(int)
        self.max_spans = 20_000

    def now(self) -> float:
        return time.monotonic() - self.start

    def add(self, category: str, label: str = "", start: float | None = None, end: float | None = None,
            agent: str | None = None) -> None:
        end = self.now() if end is None else end
        if len(self.spans) < self.max_spans:
            self.spans.append((category, agent or who(), str(label)[:80], end if start is None else start, end))

    @contextlib.contextmanager
    def span(self, category: str, label: str = "", agent: str | None = None):
        start = self.now()
        try:
            yield
        finally:
            self.add(category, label, start, self.now(), agent)

    def mark(self, name: str, **info) -> bool:
        """Record a milestone once (its first time); True if this call recorded it."""
        if name in self.milestones:
            return False
        self.milestones[name] = (self.now(), info)
        log.info("milestone %s at %s %s", name, clock(self.now()), json.dumps(info, default=str)[:200] if info else "")
        return True

    def count(self, name: str, n: int = 1) -> None:
        self.counters[name] += n

    # ---- reports --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    def totals(self, since: float = 0.0) -> dict[str, dict]:
        out: dict[str, dict] = {}
        for cat, _, _, s, e in self.spans:
            if e < since:
                continue
            t = out.setdefault(cat, {"s": 0.0, "n": 0})
            t["s"] += e - max(s, since)
            t["n"] += 1
        return {k: {"s": round(v["s"], 1), "n": v["n"]} for k, v in sorted(out.items(), key=lambda kv: -kv[1]["s"])}

    def by_agent(self, category: str) -> dict[str, float]:
        out: dict[str, float] = defaultdict(float)
        for cat, agent, _, s, e in self.spans:
            if cat == category:
                out[agent] += e - s
        return {k: round(v, 1) for k, v in sorted(out.items(), key=lambda kv: -kv[1])}

    def busy(self, category: str, agent: str | None = None) -> float:
        """Wall-clock seconds covered by at least one span of `category` (overlaps counted once)."""
        intervals = sorted((s, e) for cat, a, _, s, e in self.spans if cat == category and (agent is None or a == agent))
        total, cur_s, cur_e = 0.0, None, None
        for s, e in intervals:
            if cur_e is None or s > cur_e:
                if cur_e is not None:
                    total += cur_e - cur_s
                cur_s, cur_e = s, e
            else:
                cur_e = max(cur_e, e)
        if cur_e is not None:
            total += cur_e - cur_s
        return round(total, 1)

    def median_step(self, last: int = 40, default: float = 14.0) -> float:
        """Median duration of the latest browsing steps: the run's measured pace (model + browser)."""
        steps = [e - s for cat, _, _, s, e in self.spans if cat == "browse.step"][-last:]
        if len(steps) < 5:
            return default
        steps.sort()
        return steps[len(steps) // 2]

    def slowest(self, n: int = 8, categories=None) -> list[tuple]:
        spans = [x for x in self.spans if categories is None or x[0] in categories]
        return [(cat, agent, label, round(e - s, 1), clock(s)) for cat, agent, label, s, e in
                sorted(spans, key=lambda x: x[3] - x[4])[:n]]

    def report(self) -> dict:
        m = {k: round(v[0], 1) for k, v in sorted(self.milestones.items(), key=lambda kv: kv[1][0])}
        return {"elapsed": round(self.now(), 1), "milestones": m, "totals": self.totals(),
                "wall": {c: self.busy(c) for c in ("browse.step", "model.queue", "extract", "wait.dep", "recovery")},
                "steps_by_agent": self.by_agent("browse.step"), "waits_by_agent": self.by_agent("wait.dep"),
                "recovery_by_agent": self.by_agent("recovery"), "counters": dict(self.counters),
                "slowest": self.slowest(8, ("browse.step", "model.call", "extract", "wait.dep", "recovery",
                                           "model.queue", "browse.failed"))}

    def log_report(self) -> None:
        """A few compact lines (the platform keeps only the log's tail)."""
        r = self.report()
        log.info("TIMELINE milestones %s", json.dumps(r["milestones"]))
        log.info("TIMELINE totals %s wall %s", json.dumps(r["totals"]), json.dumps(r["wall"]))
        log.info("TIMELINE agents steps %s waits %s recovery %s", json.dumps(r["steps_by_agent"]),
                 json.dumps(r["waits_by_agent"]), json.dumps(r["recovery_by_agent"]))
        log.info("TIMELINE counters %s", json.dumps(r["counters"]))
        log.info("TIMELINE slowest %s", json.dumps(r["slowest"], default=str))

    def dump(self, path: Path) -> None:
        path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        path.write_text(json.dumps({"report": self.report(), "spans": self.spans,
                                    "milestones": {k: [round(t, 2), i] for k, (t, i) in self.milestones.items()}},
                                   default=str), encoding="utf-8")


def clock(seconds: float) -> str:
    seconds = max(0, int(seconds))
    return f"{seconds // 60:02d}:{seconds % 60:02d}"


_CURRENT = Timeline()


def current() -> Timeline:
    return _CURRENT


def reset(start: float | None = None) -> Timeline:
    global _CURRENT
    _CURRENT = Timeline(start)
    return _CURRENT


def span(category: str, label: str = "", agent: str | None = None):
    return _CURRENT.span(category, label, agent)


def add(category: str, label: str = "", start: float | None = None, end: float | None = None,
        agent: str | None = None) -> None:
    _CURRENT.add(category, label, start, end, agent)


def mark(name: str, **info) -> bool:
    return _CURRENT.mark(name, **info)


def count(name: str, n: int = 1) -> None:
    _CURRENT.count(name, n)


def now() -> float:
    return _CURRENT.now()
"""Base class for site scrapers: a model-driven browse of ONE site that streams Evidence onto the blackboard.

Subclass, set `role` ('tender' | 'spec' | 'erp' | 'mail') and `browser`, and write `goal()` (what the model should
find, in general terms derived from the brief; never scenario values). The site id for the role is resolved at run
time (datasets name their sites differently). Override `run()` for several browse passes; call `self.browse(goal)`.

When the scraper ends (done, failed or out of time) it sets results[f"done.{role}"] so analysts waiting on it start.
Independent jobs run at once with `browse_in_tabs` (a tab each, leased from swarm/scheduler.py on whichever browser
has room); `self.browse` works in the browser's main tab.
"""
import asyncio

from swarm import timeline
from swarm.agent import Agent, Phase
from swarm.blackboard import Evidence
from swarm.browser_agent import browse
from swarm.extract import brief_intro
from swarm.scheduler import scheduler
from swarm.sites import site_for

ANALYSIS_RESERVE_S = 75     # scrapers stop browsing this long before collecting ends (analysts need the time)
IDLE_STEPS = 10             # a collection browse that saved pages, then saves nothing for this many steps, ends


class SiteScraper(Agent):
    phase = Phase.COLLECT
    role: str = ""
    site_id: str = ""
    max_steps: int = 40
    hints: str = ""

    def goal(self) -> str:
        raise NotImplementedError

    def login_text(self) -> str:
        site = self.ctx.site(self.site_id)
        creds = site.get("credentials") or {}
        return f"Site ({self.role}): {site['url']}\nLogin: username {creds.get('username')!r}, password {creds.get('password')!r}"

    def task_text(self) -> str:
        facts = self.ctx.board.get("brief") or {}
        known = {k: facts.get(k) for k in ("tender_reference", "tender_title", "buyer", "scenario_date", "bidder_company")
                 if facts.get(k)}
        return f"CONTEXT:\n{brief_intro(self.ctx.brief)}\nKey facts: {known}" if known else \
            f"CONTEXT:\n{brief_intro(self.ctx.brief)}"

    async def post(self, rec: dict) -> None:
        kind = f"{self.role}.page" if rec["kind"] == "page" else rec["kind"]
        await self.ctx.board.post(Evidence(kind=kind, site=self.site_id, data=rec["data"], source=rec["source"],
                                           author=self.name, note=rec["note"]))
        if kind.endswith(".page"):
            timeline.mark(f"first {kind}")

    def stop_extra(self, kwargs: dict) -> float:
        return kwargs.get("stop_extra", ANALYSIS_RESERVE_S)

    async def browse(self, job: str, *, browser: int | None = None, max_steps: int | None = None, **kwargs) -> dict:
        prompt = "\n\n".join([self.login_text(), self.task_text(), f"YOUR JOB:\n{job}"])
        # stop browsing early enough for the analysts to turn the last pages into results before collecting ends
        kwargs.setdefault("stop_extra", ANALYSIS_RESERVE_S)
        kwargs.setdefault("idle_steps", IDLE_STEPS)
        browser = self.browser if browser is None else browser
        out = await browse(self.ctx, prompt, browser=browser, site_id=self.site_id,
                           on_record=self.post, max_steps=max_steps or self.max_steps, hints=self.hints,
                           author=kwargs.pop("author", self.name), **kwargs)
        self.log.info("browse done in %d steps, %d records: %s", out["steps"], len(out["records"]), out["summary"][:300])
        if kwargs.get("tab") is None and (out["done"] or out["records"]):
            scheduler(self.ctx).mark_warm(browser, self.site_id)      # the main tab got in: leased tabs there may too
        return out

    def time_for_retry(self, kwargs: dict, need: float = 120) -> bool:
        stop = kwargs["stop_reserve"] if kwargs.get("stop_reserve") is not None else self.ctx.stop_at(self.stop_extra(kwargs))
        return self.ctx.seconds_left() - stop >= need

    async def browse_until_done(self, job: str, attempts: int = 3, **kwargs) -> dict:
        """browse(); if the agent stopped without finishing (errors, step limit, a crashed browser agent), start again
        with a note on what is already saved, while time allows. Saved pages are never collected twice."""
        out = {"summary": "", "done": False}
        records = []
        for attempt in range(attempts):
            note = ""
            if attempt:
                saved = sorted({e.data.get("topic") for e in self.ctx.board.query(f"{self.role}.page")} - {None})
                note = (f"\n\nNOTE: previous attempt stopped early ({out['summary'][:300]!r}). Already saved: "
                        f"{saved or 'nothing'}. Do only what is missing.")
                timeline.count("browse.retries")
            try:
                out = await self.browse(job + note, **kwargs)
            except Exception as error:  # noqa: BLE001 - a failed connection is one failed attempt, not the end
                self.ctx.board.error(self.name, f"browse attempt {attempt + 1}: {type(error).__name__}: {error}")
                self.log.warning("browse attempt %d failed: %s", attempt + 1, error)
                out = {"summary": f"failed: {type(error).__name__}", "done": False, "records": [], "steps": 0}
            records.extend(out.get("records") or [])
            rejected = self.ctx.shared.get("site_invalidations", {}).get(self.role, set())
            if self.site_id in rejected:
                self.site_id = await site_for(self.ctx, self.role)
                # A reused tab may still show the old application; runtime model navigates the newly assigned URL.
                job += "\nThe prior site assignment was contradicted. Navigate to the newly assigned site URL in Login."
                out["done"] = False
            if out["done"] or not self.time_for_retry(kwargs):
                break
        return {**out, "records": records}

    async def browse_in_tabs(self, jobs: list[str], *, browser: int | None = None, attempts: int = 2,
                             **kwargs) -> list[dict]:
        """Run `jobs` at once, each in a tab leased from the scheduler (swarm/scheduler.py): on the least loaded browser,
        this scraper's browser preferred, a tab already logged in to the site reused. A failed job returns
        {"summary": error, "done": False}."""
        async def one(job: str) -> dict:
            async with scheduler(self.ctx).lease(self.site_id, prefer=self.browser if browser is None else browser) as tab:
                try:
                    return await self.browse_until_done(job, attempts=attempts, tab=tab, **kwargs)
                except Exception as error:
                    self.ctx.board.error(self.name, f"tab job failed: {error}")
                    tab.suspect = True
                    return {"summary": str(error), "done": False}
        return list(await asyncio.gather(*(one(job) for job in jobs)))

    async def wait_brief(self, timeout: float = 180) -> dict:
        try:
            return await self.ctx.board.wait_for(key="brief", timeout=timeout) or {}
        except TimeoutError:
            return {}

    def required(self) -> list[tuple[tuple[str, ...], str]]:
        """Pages that must be saved, as (topic keywords, focused job). After the main browse, a focused browse runs
        for each one whose keywords appear in no saved topic. Override per scraper."""
        return []

    def saved_topics(self) -> str:
        return " | ".join(str(e.data.get("topic", "")).lower() for e in self.ctx.board.query(f"{self.role}.page"))

    async def run(self) -> None:
        try:
            self.site_id = self.site_id or await site_for(self.ctx, self.role)
            out = await self.browse_until_done(self.goal())   # the brief's intro already names the tender: start at once
            await self.ctx.board.set(f"{self.name}.summary", out["summary"])
            await self.required_pass()
        finally:
            await self.ctx.board.set(f"done.{self.role}", True)

    async def required_pass(self) -> None:
        for keywords, job in self.required():
            if self.ctx.time_left() > 90 and not any(k in self.saved_topics() for k in keywords):
                self.log.warning("nothing saved for %s: focused browse", keywords)
                await self.browse_until_done(job, attempts=1, max_steps=15)


def scraper_class(role: str) -> type[SiteScraper] | None:
    from swarm.agent import REGISTRY
    return next((c for c in REGISTRY if isinstance(c, type) and issubclass(c, SiteScraper) and c.role == role), None)


async def run_job(ctx, role: str, job: str, *, max_steps: int = 16, **kwargs) -> dict:
    """One follow-up job on the site of `role`, run by that role's scraper setup (login, hints, browser): in the
    browser's main tab when it is free (logged in already), else in a leased tab. For agents/coordinate.py."""
    cls = scraper_class(role)
    if cls is None:
        raise KeyError(f"no scraper for role {role!r}")
    scraper = cls(ctx)
    scraper.name = f"{cls.__name__}.followup"
    scraper.site_id = await site_for(ctx, role)
    from swarm.browser_agent import _ACTIVE, main_tab
    main = ctx.lock(f"main_tab.{scraper.browser}")
    if not main.locked() and main_tab(scraper.browser) not in _ACTIVE:
        async with main:
            return await scraper.browse_until_done(job, attempts=1, max_steps=max_steps, **kwargs)
    return (await scraper.browse_in_tabs([job], attempts=1, max_steps=max_steps, **kwargs))[0]
# OWNER: (shared)   ROLE: coordinator (model with reasoning; no browser of its own)
# NEEDS: every analyst's results   WRITES: results["gaps"], follow-up evidence through the scrapers' sites
"""Decides what the scrapers collect next, so the run ends COLLECT with the data the bid needs instead of with what
the first pass happened to save.

While the first pass runs, the coordinator watches the board. As soon as a site's first pass and its analysis are done,
code lists the GAPS on that site: concrete facts the bid needs that no saved page holds (a position without a
matching material, a material without status / price scales / stock, a commercial key from the Q&A without its mail,
a usable-travel requirement without its technical release, no discount approval, ...). The model (with reasoning) turns
the gaps into a few focused jobs, one browser agent each, grouping what one agent can do in one go and skipping gaps the
saved pages show do not exist. Jobs run at once, in the site's browser (main tab when free, new tabs otherwise). After
each job the affected analyses run again on the new pages, which may reveal the next gaps.

No gap is worked on twice, every job states exactly what to read (so no two agents collect the same thing), and a page
another agent already saved is not opened again (read_page returns the saved text). Follow-ups stop when nothing is
missing, nothing new can be tried, or the collect time is used up.
"""
import asyncio
import json

from agents import analyze_discount, analyze_materials, analyze_quantities, analyze_requirements
from agents.compute_bid import INPUTS, compute, position_keys, valid_condition
from swarm import Agent, Phase, register, timeline

def find_gaps(board, ready: set[str], saved_topics: dict[str, list[str]]) -> list[dict]:
