    mail = board.get("mail") or {}
    erp_materials = {norm_ref(k): v for k, v in (erp.get("materials") or {}).items()}
    scenario = to_datetime(brief.get("scenario_date"))
    if "tender" in ready and not positions:
        gap("tender", "tender positions", "bill of quantities / position overview: positions, quantities, units, "
                                          "requirement references")
    if positions and not tender.get("clarifications"):
        gap("tender", "tender q&a", "bidder Q&A of the tender, all pages (if the tender has any)")
    if (board.get("discount") or {}).get("source") in ("no valid approval found", "latest approval invalid"):
        gap("mail", "mail discount", f"sales director's discount approval for {brief.get('tender_reference')} "
                                     "(inbox and archive)")
    clarifications = tender.get("clarifications") or []
    for p in positions:
        pos = str(p.get("position")).strip()
        ref = p.get("requirement_ref")
        req = next((v for k, v in requirements.items() if norm_ref(k) == norm_ref(ref)), None)
        if req is None:
            gap("spec", f"spec requirement {ref}", f"requirement {ref} of the CURRENT specification revision (bore, "
                                                   "stroke, pressure, mounting, certification, catalogue group)")
            continue
        group = req.get("kataloggruppe") or ""
        if req.get("stroke_kind") == "usable":
            releases = mail.get("technical_release") or {}
            if not releases:
                gap("mail", "mail technical release",
                    f"technical release mail with end reserves per stroke end (revision {req.get('revision')}"
                    f"{', key ' + str(req.get('reserve_key')) if req.get('reserve_key') else ''})")
        for key, value in position_keys(clarifications, pos)["keys"].items():
            section, label = KEY_SECTIONS.get(key, (None, None))
            if section and norm_ref(value) not in {norm_ref(k) for k in (mail.get(section) or {})}:
                gap("mail", f"mail {section} {norm_ref(value)}", f"{label} mail for key {value}")
        m = materials.get(pos) or {}
        if not m:
            gap("erp", f"erp search {group or ref}", f"Find materials for requirement {ref}: {_attrs(req)}")
            continue
        mat = m.get("material")
        if not mat:
            searched = any(norm_ref(group) and norm_ref(group) in norm_ref(t) for t in saved_topics.get("erp", []))
            in_group = [v["material"] for v in erp_materials.values()
                        if norm_ref(v.get("kataloggruppe")) == norm_ref(group)] if group else []
            if not searched and not in_group:
                gap("erp", f"erp search {group or ref}", f"search result list of catalogue group {group} "
                                                         f"(requirement {ref}: {_attrs(req)})")
            elif m.get("reason") == "only blocked matches":
                gap("erp", f"erp status {group or ref}", f"status (active/blocked, from record and status legend) of "
                                                         f"{[c['material'] for c in m.get('candidates') or []]}: all "
                                                         f"read as blocked for requirement {ref}")
            else:
                gap("erp", f"erp records {group or ref}", f"record pages (technical data incl. stroke and "
                                                          f"certification, status) of materials {in_group or 'of group ' + group}: "
                                                          f"none matched requirement {ref} ({_attrs(req)}) on the pages "
                                                          "read")
            continue
        info = erp_materials.get(norm_ref(mat)) or {}
        missing = [a for a in m.get("unverified") or []]
        if info.get("lead_time_production_weeks") in (None, ""):
            missing.append("lead times")
        if position_keys(clarifications, pos)["keys"].get("packaging_tariff") and not info.get("pieces_per_carton"):
            missing.append("pieces per carton")
        if missing:
            gap("erp", f"erp record {norm_ref(mat)}", f"record of material {mat} (all tabs, status legend): "
                                                      f"{', '.join(dict.fromkeys(missing))} not read")
        conds = [c for c in erp.get("conditions") or [] if norm_ref(c.get("material")) == norm_ref(mat)]
        cond = valid_condition(conds, mat, scenario)
        if not conds:
            gap("erp", f"erp prices {norm_ref(mat)}", f"price condition records of material {mat} with quantity scales")
        elif cond is None:
            gap("erp", f"erp prices {norm_ref(mat)}", f"price condition of material {mat} valid on "
                                                      f"{brief.get('scenario_date')} (read: "
                                                      f"{[(c.get('valid_from'), c.get('valid_to')) for c in conds]}; "
                                                      "other condition records/periods)")
        elif not cond.get("scales"):
            gap("erp", f"erp prices {norm_ref(mat)}", f"quantity scales of the valid price condition of {mat} (open "
                                                      "the quantity-scale register)")
        elif norm_ref(cond.get("currency") or "EUR") != "EUR" and \
                norm_ref(cond.get("currency")) not in {norm_ref(k) for k in (mail.get("fx_fixing") or {})}:
            gap("mail", f"mail fx {norm_ref(cond.get('currency'))}", f"FX fixing mail for {cond.get('currency')} "
                                                                     f"(key {cond.get('fx_key')})")
        if norm_ref(mat) not in {norm_ref(k) for k in (erp.get("stock") or {})}:
            gap("erp", f"erp stock {norm_ref(mat)}", f"stock of material {mat} at storage-location level")
        index = info.get("metal_index")
        if index and norm_ref(index) not in {norm_ref(k) for k in (mail.get("price_indices") or {})}:
            gap("mail", f"mail price index {norm_ref(index)}", f"metal price index mail for {index} valid on "
                                                               f"{brief.get('scenario_date')}")
    # What the calculation itself still misses (a condition without price unit, a pool fee, a carton size, ...):
    # checks above establish that a topic exists; these establish that the value the bid needs is usable.
    for dep in dependency_gaps(board):
        if dep["role"] not in ready:
            continue
        have = gaps.get(dep["id"])
        if have is None:
            gaps[dep["id"]] = {"id": dep["id"], "role": dep["role"], "need": dep["need"]}
        elif dep["need"] not in have["need"]:
            have["need"] += f"; calculation needs: {dep['need']}"
    return list(gaps.values())


def direct_jobs(gaps: list[dict], per_job: int = 3) -> list[dict]:
    """Jobs straight from the gap list (planner failed or left gaps out): up to `per_job` gaps of one site per job,
    each stating what to find. The browsing agent still decides where to look."""
    by_role: dict[str, list[dict]] = {}
    for g in gaps:
        by_role.setdefault(g["role"], []).append(g)
    jobs = []
    for role, items in by_role.items():
        for i in range(0, len(items), per_job):
            group = items[i:i + per_job]
            jobs.append({"role": role, "gaps": [g["id"] for g in group],
                         "job": "Find and read_page each of these (topic = the label given): " + "; ".join(
                             f"'{g['id']}': {g.get('need') or g['id']}" for g in group)})
    return jobs


def dependency_gaps(board) -> list[dict]:
    """The bid calculation's open dependencies on the sites (not the ones on other positions), with the positions
    each one blocks. Material matching is left to find_gaps' search/record gaps (more specific)."""
    try:
        bid = compute({n: board.get(n) for n in INPUTS})
    except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001 - a half-collected board: the gaps above still apply
        return []
    return [{"id": d["id"], "role": d["role"], "need": f"{d['need']} (positions {', '.join(d['positions'])})"}
            for d in (bid.get("dependencies") or {}).values()
            if d["role"] in READY and d.get("kind") != "material"]


async def refresh(ctx, roles: set[str]) -> None:
    """Run the analyses that depend on new pages of `roles` again (each failure is only logged)."""
    steps = []
    if "tender" in roles:
        steps += [analyze_quantities.refresh]
    if roles & {"tender", "spec"} and pages(ctx, "spec"):
        steps += [analyze_requirements.refresh]
    if "mail" in roles:
        steps += [analyze_discount.refresh]
    if pages(ctx, "erp"):
        steps += [analyze_materials.refresh]
    for step in steps:
        try:
            await step(ctx)
        except Exception as error:
            ctx.board.error("CollectionCoordinator", f"refresh {step.__module__}: {error}")


@register
class CollectionCoordinator(Agent):
    phase = Phase.COLLECT

    def __init__(self, ctx):
        super().__init__(ctx)
        self.tried: set[str] = set()
        self.attempts: dict[str, int] = {}
        self.running: dict[asyncio.Task, str] = {}      # follow-up job -> its site role
        self.active: dict[asyncio.Task, dict] = {}      # follow-up job -> the job (gaps + text) it runs
        self.history: list[dict] = []
        self.first_pass_end: dict[str, float] = {}
        self.mail_core_at: float | None = None
        self.last_offer: frozenset = frozenset()
        self.last_plan_at = -1e9

    def ready(self) -> set[str]:
        """Sites whose first pass and analysis are done (gaps can be judged). The mail counts once its index pass
        was analysed for MAIL_EARLY_S: key-specific gaps (a packaging tariff, a pool fee) need not wait for the
        generic topic searches."""
        out = {role for role, keys in READY.items() if all(self.ctx.board.get(k) is not None for k in keys)}
        if self.ctx.board.get("done.mail_core") is not None and self.ctx.board.get("mail") is not None:
            self.mail_core_at = self.mail_core_at if self.mail_core_at is not None else self.ctx.elapsed()
            if self.ctx.elapsed() - self.mail_core_at >= MAIL_EARLY_S:
                out.add("mail")
        return out

    def settled(self) -> set[str]:
        """Ready sites, plus sites whose analysis has not finished SETTLE_S after the first pass (it failed)."""
        now = self.ctx.elapsed()
        for role, (done_key, _) in READY.items():
            if self.ctx.board.get(done_key) is not None:
                self.first_pass_end.setdefault(role, now)
        return self.ready() | {r for r, t in self.first_pass_end.items() if now - t > SETTLE_S}

    def saved_topics(self) -> dict[str, list[str]]:
        return {role: sorted({str(e.data.get("topic", "")).lower() for e in pages(self.ctx, role)} - {""})
                for role in READY}

    def brief_rules(self, limit: int = 3500) -> str:
        """The brief after its intro (the rules the bid follows), so the planner knows what each gap is for."""
        brief = self.ctx.brief or ""
        return brief[len(brief_intro(brief, 10**6)):].strip()[:limit]

    def position_status(self) -> list[dict]:
        """Per tender position: requirement ref, matched material (or why none) and what the bid still lacks."""
        board = self.ctx.board
        materials = board.get("materials") or {}
        out = []
        for p in (board.get("tender") or {}).get("positions") or []:
            pos = str(p.get("position")).strip()
            m = materials.get(pos) or {}
            row = {"position": pos, "requirement": p.get("requirement_ref"),
                   "material": m.get("material") or m.get("reason") or "not searched"}
            if m.get("unverified"):
                row["unverified"] = m["unverified"]
            out.append(row)
        return out[:40]

    async def plan(self, gaps: list[dict]) -> list[dict]:
        board = self.ctx.board
        summaries = {k: str(v)[:600] for k, v in board.results.items() if k.endswith(".summary")}
        prompt = {"tender_reference": (board.get("brief") or {}).get("tender_reference"),
                  "scenario_date": (board.get("brief") or {}).get("scenario_date"),
                  "gaps": gaps, "sites": {r: SITES[r] for r in {g["role"] for g in gaps}},
                  "saved_topics": self.saved_topics(), "first_pass_summaries": summaries,
                  "observed_pages": [{"source": e.source or e.data.get("url"), "text": e.data.get("text", "")[:1800]}
                                     for role in {g["role"] for g in gaps} for e in pages(self.ctx, role)[-3:]],
                  "earlier_followups": self.history[-8:], "site_tips": board.get("tips") or {},
                  "brief_rules": self.brief_rules(), "position_status": self.position_status(),
                  "running_now": [{"role": j["role"], "gaps": j["gaps"], "job": j["job"][:200]}
                                  for j in self.active.values()],
                  "time_left_s": round(self.ctx.time_left())}
        known = {g["id"]: g for g in gaps}
        try:
            # no thinking: with it the planner timed out twice (110 s) in run C, no mail follow-up ran and the
            # discount, surcharges, packaging and bonus stayed missing
            reply = await asyncio.wait_for(
                self.ctx.llm.ask_json(SYSTEM, json.dumps(prompt, ensure_ascii=False, default=str)), PLAN_TIMEOUT_S)
        except Exception as error:  # noqa: BLE001 - every gap still gets a job: the agents read what each gap names
            self.log.warning("planning failed (%s): one direct job per gap group", type(error).__name__)
            return direct_jobs(gaps)
        jobs, per_role = [], {}
        for j in (reply or {}).get("jobs") or []:
            role = j.get("role")
            ids = [i for i in j.get("gaps") or [] if i in known and known[i]["role"] == role]
            if role not in READY or not ids or not str(j.get("job") or "").strip():
                continue
            if per_role.get(role, 0) >= MAX_JOBS_PER_ROLE or len(jobs) >= MAX_JOBS:
                continue
            per_role[role] = per_role.get(role, 0) + 1
            jobs.append({"role": role, "gaps": ids, "job": str(j["job"]).strip()})
        skipped = []
        for item in (reply or {}).get("skipped") or []:
            if not isinstance(item, dict) or item.get("id") not in known:
                continue
            gid = item["id"]
            if gid == "tender positions" or gid.startswith("spec requirement "):
                continue
            quote = " ".join(str(item.get("quote") or "").split())
            if len(quote) >= 12 and any(
                item.get("source") == (e.source or e.data.get("url"))
                and quote in " ".join(str(e.data.get("text") or "").split())
                for e in pages(self.ctx, known[gid]["role"])
            ):
                skipped.append(gid)
        if skipped:
            self.log.info("gaps skipped by the model: %s", skipped)
        self.tried |= set(skipped)
        planned = {g for j in jobs for g in j["gaps"]} | set(skipped)
        left = [g for g in gaps if g["id"] not in planned]      # a gap the model neither planned nor proved absent
        for job in direct_jobs(left):
            if per_role.get(job["role"], 0) < MAX_JOBS_PER_ROLE:
                per_role[job["role"]] = per_role.get(job["role"], 0) + 1
                jobs.append(job)
        return jobs

    async def work(self, job: dict) -> None:
        try:
            with timeline.span("followup", f"{job['role']} {','.join(job['gaps'])[:60]}"):
                out = await run_job(self.ctx, job["role"], job["job"], max_steps=JOB_STEPS, stop_extra=ANALYSIS_S)
            self.history.append({"role": job["role"], "gaps": job["gaps"], "done": out.get("done"),
                                 "summary": str(out.get("summary"))[:300]})
            self.log.info("follow-up %s %s done=%s: %s", job["role"], job["gaps"], out.get("done"),
                          str(out.get("summary"))[:200])
        except Exception as error:
            self.ctx.board.error(self.name, f"follow-up {job['gaps']}: {error}")
            self.tried.difference_update(job["gaps"])
        if not locals().get("out", {}).get("done"):
            self.tried.difference_update(job["gaps"])
        await refresh(self.ctx, {job["role"]})

    async def run(self) -> None:
        try:
            while True:
                ready = self.settled()
                if self.ctx.time_left() > ROUND_MIN_S:
                    gaps = [g for g in find_gaps(self.ctx.board, ready, self.saved_topics()) if g["id"] not in self.tried and self.attempts.get(g["id"], 0) < 2]
                    # a site with follow-ups running still takes new, different gaps while it has a free slot
                    busy = {r: list(self.running.values()).count(r) for r in set(self.running.values())}
                    gaps = [g for g in gaps if busy.get(g["role"], 0) < MAX_RUNNING_PER_ROLE]
                    offer = frozenset(g["id"] for g in gaps)
                    if gaps and offer == self.last_offer and self.ctx.elapsed() - self.last_plan_at < REPLAN_S:
                        gaps = []                 # the same gaps were just planned (model skipped them): not again yet
                    if gaps:
                        self.last_offer, self.last_plan_at = offer, self.ctx.elapsed()
                        self.log.info("gaps: %s", [g["id"] for g in gaps])
                        try:
                            jobs = await self.plan(gaps)
                        except Exception as error:
                            self.log.warning("planning failed: %s", error)
                            jobs = []
                        for job in jobs:
                            if busy.get(job["role"], 0) >= MAX_RUNNING_PER_ROLE:
                                continue                  # its gaps stay open for the next round
                            busy[job["role"]] = busy.get(job["role"], 0) + 1
                            for gid in job["gaps"]:
                                self.attempts[gid] = self.attempts.get(gid, 0) + 1
                            self.tried.update(job["gaps"])
                            task = asyncio.create_task(self.work(job))
                            self.running[task] = job["role"]
                            self.active[task] = job
                            task.add_done_callback(lambda t: (self.running.pop(t, None), self.active.pop(t, None)))
                all_done = self.settled() == set(READY)
                if self.running:
                    await asyncio.wait(list(self.running), timeout=5)
                    continue
                pending = [g for g in find_gaps(self.ctx.board, ready, self.saved_topics())
                           if g["id"] not in self.tried and self.attempts.get(g["id"], 0) < 2]
                if (all_done and not pending) or self.ctx.time_left() <= ROUND_MIN_S:
                    gaps = find_gaps(self.ctx.board, set(READY), self.saved_topics())
                    await self.ctx.board.set("gaps", gaps)
                    await self.ctx.board.set("collect_complete", True)    # mail topic tabs still searching end now
                    self.log.info("collect complete; open gaps: %s", [g["id"] for g in gaps])
                    return
                await asyncio.sleep(5)
        finally:
            tasks = list(self.running)
            for task in tasks:
                task.cancel()
            await asyncio.gather(*tasks, return_exceptions=True)

        self.errors: list[dict] = []

    async def post(self, item: Evidence) -> None:

    def query(self, kind: str | None = None, site: str | None = None, prefix: bool = False) -> list[Evidence]:

    async def set(self, key: str, value) -> None:
        async with self._changed:
            self.results[key] = value

    def get(self, key: str, default=None):

    def to_json(self) -> dict:
        return {"evidence": [asdict(e) for e in self.evidence], "results": self.results, "errors": self.errors}

"""Runs the registered agents phase by phase. Agents of one phase run concurrently; a failing agent never stops others.

Time: non-SUBMIT phases are cut off when the useful time is gone (ctx.time_left() <= 0), then SUBMIT always runs.
Local dev: SWARM_ONLY=a,b runs only those agents; SWARM_BOARD_IN=.swarm/board.json preloads a saved board (ignored
in scored runs). The board is dumped to .swarm/board.json after every phase.
"""
import asyncio
import importlib
import json
import logging
import os
import pkgutil
import time
from pathlib import Path

import agents as agents_pkg
from swarm.agent import REGISTRY, Agent, Phase
from swarm.blackboard import Blackboard
from swarm.browser_pool import BrowserPool
from swarm.context import Context
from swarm.llm import LLM

log = logging.getLogger("swarm")
BOARD_DUMP = Path(".swarm/board.json")
RUN_STATS = Path(".swarm/run_stats.json")
TIMINGS: dict[str, float] = {}
# Qwen's published prices per million tokens (input, cached input, output): the simulated cost the ranking uses
PRICE = {"prompt": 0.15, "cached": 0.016, "completion": 0.47}


def run_report(ctx, phases: dict) -> dict:
    """Time and tokens per phase, agent and browser: one JSON object, logged and (locally) saved."""
    board = ctx.board
    browse = {k.split(".", 1)[1]: v for k, v in board.results.items() if k.startswith("stats.") and isinstance(v, dict)}
    prompt = ctx.llm.tokens["prompt"] + sum(v.get("prompt_tokens") or 0 for v in browse.values())
    cached = sum(v.get("cached_tokens") or 0 for v in browse.values())
    completion = ctx.llm.tokens["completion"] + sum(v.get("completion_tokens") or 0 for v in browse.values())
    kinds: dict[str, int] = {}
    for e in board.evidence:
        kinds[e.kind] = kinds.get(e.kind, 0) + 1
    for v in browse.values():
        steps = v.pop("step_seconds", None) or []
        if steps:
            v["step_seconds_mean"] = round(sum(steps) / len(steps), 1)
            v["step_seconds_max"] = max(steps)
    return {
        "elapsed": round(ctx.elapsed(), 1), "phases": phases, "agents": TIMINGS, "browse": browse,
        "direct_llm": {"calls": ctx.llm.calls, **ctx.llm.tokens},
        "tokens": {"prompt": prompt, "cached": cached, "completion": completion},
        "cost_usd": round(((prompt - cached) * PRICE["prompt"] + cached * PRICE["cached"]
                           + completion * PRICE["completion"]) / 1e6, 4),
        "evidence": kinds, "errors": board.errors,
        "submission": board.get("submission"),
    }


def discover() -> list[type[Agent]]:
    """Import every module in agents/ so its @register decorators run."""
    for mod in pkgutil.iter_modules(agents_pkg.__path__):
        importlib.import_module(f"agents.{mod.name}")
    return list(REGISTRY)


def select(classes: list[type[Agent]], only: str | None) -> list[type[Agent]]:
    if not only:
        return classes
    wanted = {n.strip() for n in only.split(",") if n.strip()}

"""Model access for agents: concurrency-limited, usage-counted, JSON-friendly. Qwen by default (hosted, free)."""
import asyncio
import json
import re
import os
import httpx

CALL_TIMEOUT_S = float(os.environ.get("SWARM_MODEL_TIMEOUT_S", "55"))
HTTP_TIMEOUT = httpx.Timeout(CALL_TIMEOUT_S, connect=8, write=15, pool=8)

import models
from openai import APIConnectionError, APIStatusError
from swarm import timeline

# Model slots (team limit: 32 concurrent Qwen calls). Browsing steps take a slot of the total; analysis, planning and
# guard calls also take one of the analysis slots, so extraction can never starve the browsing agents.
MAX_CONCURRENT = int(os.environ.get("SWARM_LLM_CONCURRENCY", "16"))
ANALYSIS_CONCURRENT = int(os.environ.get("SWARM_ANALYSIS_CONCURRENCY", "0")) or max(1, MAX_CONCURRENT // 2)


def parse_json(text: str):
    """The first JSON object/array in a model reply (tolerates ``` fences and chatter)."""
    text = re.sub(r"^```(?:json)?|```$", "", text.strip(), flags=re.M).strip()
    for opener, closer in (("{", "}"), ("[", "]")):
        start, end = text.find(opener), text.rfind(closer)
        if start != -1 and end > start:
            try:
                return json.loads(text[start:end + 1])
            except ValueError:
                continue
    raise ValueError(f"no JSON in model reply: {text[:200]}")


class LLM:
    def __init__(self, max_concurrent: int = MAX_CONCURRENT, analysis_concurrent: int | None = None):
        self._sem = asyncio.Semaphore(max_concurrent)   # team limit is 32 concurrent Qwen calls
        self._analysis_sem = asyncio.Semaphore(analysis_concurrent or
                                               (ANALYSIS_CONCURRENT if max_concurrent == MAX_CONCURRENT
                                                else max(1, max_concurrent // 2)))
        self._client = None
        self.calls = 0
        self.tokens = {"prompt": 0, "completion": 0}

    @property
    def client(self):
        self._client = self._client or models.qwen().with_options(timeout=HTTP_TIMEOUT, max_retries=0)
        return self._client

    async def chat(self, messages: list[dict], *, tools: list[dict] | None = None, model: str = models.QWEN_MODEL,
                   think: bool = False, **kwargs):
        """One chat completion; returns the message (`.content`, `.tool_calls`). `think=True` lets Qwen run its
        separate reasoning pass (slower, more tokens): use it for judgement calls, not for plain extraction."""
        args = dict(model=model, messages=messages, **kwargs)
        args.setdefault("temperature", 0)
        if not think and model == models.QWEN_MODEL:
            args["extra_body"] = {**(args.get("extra_body") or {}), **models.NO_THINKING}
        if tools:
            args["tools"] = tools
        queued = timeline.now()
        async with self._analysis_sem, self._sem:
            timeline.add("model.queue", "analysis", queued)
            # Bound each attempt, including providers that leave a connection open without replying.
            for attempt in range(2):
                started = timeline.now()
                try:
                    async with asyncio.timeout(CALL_TIMEOUT_S):
                        reply = await self.client.chat.completions.create(**args)
                    timeline.add("model.call", "think" if think else "chat", started)
                    break
                except (TimeoutError, models.httpx.TransportError, APIConnectionError) as error:
                    timeline.add("recovery", f"model {type(error).__name__}", started)
                    timeline.count("model.failed")
                    if attempt:
                        raise
                    await asyncio.sleep(0.5)
                except APIStatusError as error:
                    timeline.add("recovery", f"model HTTP {error.status_code}", started)
                    timeline.count("model.failed")
                    if attempt or (error.status_code < 500 and error.status_code != 429):
                        raise
                    await asyncio.sleep(0.5)
        self.calls += 1
        if reply.usage:
            self.tokens["prompt"] += reply.usage.prompt_tokens or 0
            self.tokens["completion"] += reply.usage.completion_tokens or 0
        return reply.choices[0].message

    async def ask(self, system: str, user: str, **kwargs) -> str:
        message = await self.chat([{"role": "system", "content": system}, {"role": "user", "content": user}], **kwargs)
        return message.content or ""

    async def ask_json(self, system: str, user: str, retries: int = 1, **kwargs):
        """Ask for JSON; re-ask once with the parse error if the reply is not valid."""
        messages = [{"role": "system", "content": system}, {"role": "user", "content": user}]
        kwargs.setdefault("response_format", {"type": "json_object"})    # Qwen then always answers with JSON
        for _ in range(retries + 1):
            reply = (await self.chat(messages, **kwargs)).content or ""
            try:
                return parse_json(reply)
            except ValueError as error:
                messages += [{"role": "assistant", "content": reply},
                             {"role": "user", "content": f"Invalid: {error}. Reply with valid JSON only."}]
        raise ValueError("model did not return valid JSON")
"""Where a run's time goes: spans (useful work, waits, recovery, model queue, extraction) and milestones.

The platform keeps only the tail of a run's log, so the timeline logs compact lines: a progress line per minute during
collection, one line per milestone, and a short report at the end (category totals, slowest spans, repeated work, time
to first usable bid / complete positions / accepted submission). Locally the full span list is written to `.swarm/`.

    with timeline.span("wait.dep", "requirements"):      # who: the running agent (context variable)
        ...
    timeline.mark("first usable bid", positions=2)       # milestone, first occurrence only
    timeline.count("reads.repeat")                        # repeated work

Categories:
  browse.step     one browsing step (model reply + action + page state): the useful browser work
  model.queue     waiting for a free model slot (our concurrency limit)
  model.call      model latency (analysis, planning, guard; browsing steps contain their own call)
  extract         saved page -> facts (model extraction)
  wait.dep        an agent waiting for an upstream result
  recovery        browser checks, hung tabs, reattaching, retries after failures
  guard           popup sweeps before a step
  browse.failed   whole browses that ended without success (repeated later)
"""
import contextlib
import contextvars
import json
import logging
import time
from collections import defaultdict
from pathlib import Path

log = logging.getLogger("timeline")

AGENT: contextvars.ContextVar[str] = contextvars.ContextVar("swarm_agent", default="-")


def who() -> str:
    return AGENT.get()


class Timeline:
    def __init__(self, start: float | None = None):
        self.start = time.monotonic() if start is None else start
        self.spans: list[tuple[str, str, str, float, float]] = []   # category, agent, label, start, end (run clock)
        self.milestones: dict[str, tuple[float, dict]] = {}
        self.counters: dict[str, int] = defaultdict(int)
        self.max_spans = 20_000

    def now(self) -> float:
        return time.monotonic() - self.start

    def add(self, category: str, label: str = "", start: float | None = None, end: float | None = None,
            agent: str | None = None) -> None:
        end = self.now() if end is None else end
        if len(self.spans) < self.max_spans:
            self.spans.append((category, agent or who(), str(label)[:80], end if start is None else start, end))

    @contextlib.contextmanager
    def span(self, category: str, label: str = "", agent: str | None = None):
        start = self.now()
        try:
            yield
        finally:
            self.add(category, label, start, self.now(), agent)

    def mark(self, name: str, **info) -> bool:
        """Record a milestone once (its first time); True if this call recorded it."""
        if name in self.milestones:
            return False
        self.milestones[name] = (self.now(), info)
        log.info("milestone %s at %s %s", name, clock(self.now()), json.dumps(info, default=str)[:200] if info else "")
        return True

    def count(self, name: str, n: int = 1) -> None:
        self.counters[name] += n

    # ---- reports --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    def totals(self, since: float = 0.0) -> dict[str, dict]:
        out: dict[str, dict] = {}
        for cat, _, _, s, e in self.spans:
            if e < since:
                continue
            t = out.setdefault(cat, {"s": 0.0, "n": 0})
            t["s"] += e - max(s, since)
            t["n"] += 1
        return {k: {"s": round(v["s"], 1), "n": v["n"]} for k, v in sorted(out.items(), key=lambda kv: -kv[1]["s"])}

    def by_agent(self, category: str) -> dict[str, float]:
        out: dict[str, float] = defaultdict(float)
        for cat, agent, _, s, e in self.spans:
            if cat == category:
                out[agent] += e - s
        return {k: round(v, 1) for k, v in sorted(out.items(), key=lambda kv: -kv[1])}

    def busy(self, category: str, agent: str | None = None) -> float:
        """Wall-clock seconds covered by at least one span of `category` (overlaps counted once)."""
        intervals = sorted((s, e) for cat, a, _, s, e in self.spans if cat == category and (agent is None or a == agent))
        total, cur_s, cur_e = 0.0, None, None
        for s, e in intervals:
            if cur_e is None or s > cur_e:
                if cur_e is not None:
                    total += cur_e - cur_s
                cur_s, cur_e = s, e
            else:
                cur_e = max(cur_e, e)
        if cur_e is not None:
            total += cur_e - cur_s
        return round(total, 1)

    def median_step(self, last: int = 40, default: float = 14.0) -> float:
        """Median duration of the latest browsing steps: the run's measured pace (model + browser)."""
        steps = [e - s for cat, _, _, s, e in self.spans if cat == "browse.step"][-last:]
        if len(steps) < 5:
            return default
        steps.sort()
        return steps[len(steps) // 2]

    def slowest(self, n: int = 8, categories=None) -> list[tuple]:
        spans = [x for x in self.spans if categories is None or x[0] in categories]
        return [(cat, agent, label, round(e - s, 1), clock(s)) for cat, agent, label, s, e in
                sorted(spans, key=lambda x: x[3] - x[4])[:n]]

    def report(self) -> dict:
        m = {k: round(v[0], 1) for k, v in sorted(self.milestones.items(), key=lambda kv: kv[1][0])}
        return {"elapsed": round(self.now(), 1), "milestones": m, "totals": self.totals(),
                "wall": {c: self.busy(c) for c in ("browse.step", "model.queue", "extract", "wait.dep", "recovery")},
                "steps_by_agent": self.by_agent("browse.step"), "waits_by_agent": self.by_agent("wait.dep"),
                "recovery_by_agent": self.by_agent("recovery"), "counters": dict(self.counters),
                "slowest": self.slowest(8, ("browse.step", "model.call", "extract", "wait.dep", "recovery",
                                           "model.queue", "browse.failed"))}

    def log_report(self) -> None:
        """A few compact lines (the platform keeps only the log's tail)."""
        r = self.report()
        log.info("TIMELINE milestones %s", json.dumps(r["milestones"]))
        log.info("TIMELINE totals %s wall %s", json.dumps(r["totals"]), json.dumps(r["wall"]))
        log.info("TIMELINE agents steps %s waits %s recovery %s", json.dumps(r["steps_by_agent"]),
                 json.dumps(r["waits_by_agent"]), json.dumps(r["recovery_by_agent"]))
        log.info("TIMELINE counters %s", json.dumps(r["counters"]))
        log.info("TIMELINE slowest %s", json.dumps(r["slowest"], default=str))

    def dump(self, path: Path) -> None:
        path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        path.write_text(json.dumps({"report": self.report(), "spans": self.spans,
                                    "milestones": {k: [round(t, 2), i] for k, (t, i) in self.milestones.items()}},
                                   default=str), encoding="utf-8")


def clock(seconds: float) -> str:
    seconds = max(0, int(seconds))
    return f"{seconds // 60:02d}:{seconds % 60:02d}"


_CURRENT = Timeline()


def current() -> Timeline:
    return _CURRENT


def reset(start: float | None = None) -> Timeline:
    global _CURRENT
    _CURRENT = Timeline(start)
    return _CURRENT


def span(category: str, label: str = "", agent: str | None = None):
    return _CURRENT.span(category, label, agent)


def add(category: str, label: str = "", start: float | None = None, end: float | None = None,
        agent: str | None = None) -> None:
    _CURRENT.add(category, label, start, end, agent)


def mark(name: str, **info) -> bool:
    return _CURRENT.mark(name, **info)


def count(name: str, n: int = 1) -> None:
    _CURRENT.count(name, n)


def now() -> float:
    return _CURRENT.now()
"""Runs the registered agents phase by phase. Agents of one phase run concurrently; a failing agent never stops others.

Time: COLLECT/ANALYZE are cut off when the useful time is gone (ctx.time_left() <= 0); VERIFY and COMPUTE (plain code,
instant) and SUBMIT always run.
Local dev: SWARM_ONLY=a,b runs only those agents; SWARM_BOARD_IN=.swarm/board.json preloads a saved board (ignored
in scored runs). The board is dumped to .swarm/board.json after every phase.
"""
import asyncio
import faulthandler
import importlib
import logging
import os
import pkgutil
import sys
from pathlib import Path

import agents as agents_pkg
from swarm import timeline
from swarm.agent import REGISTRY, Agent, Phase
from swarm.blackboard import Blackboard
from swarm.browser_pool import BrowserPool
from swarm.context import FINAL_MARGIN_S, Context
from swarm.llm import LLM

log = logging.getLogger("swarm")
BOARD_DUMP = Path(".swarm/board.json")
TIMELINE_DUMP = Path(".swarm/timeline.json")
PROGRESS_EVERY_S = float(os.environ.get("SWARM_PROGRESS_S", "60"))


def discover() -> list[type[Agent]]:
    """Import every module in agents/ so its @register decorators run."""
    for mod in pkgutil.iter_modules(agents_pkg.__path__):
        importlib.import_module(f"agents.{mod.name}")
    return list(REGISTRY)


def select(classes: list[type[Agent]], only: str | None) -> list[type[Agent]]:
    if not only:
        return classes
    wanted = {n.strip() for n in only.split(",") if n.strip()}
    return [c for c in classes if (c.name or c.__name__) in wanted or c.__name__ in wanted]


# Plain-code phases (cross-checks, the bid arithmetic) take well under a second: they run even when collecting used up
# its time, otherwise the submitter would get no bid at all (it then omits every position).
ALWAYS = (Phase.VERIFY, Phase.COMPUTE, Phase.SUBMIT)
QUICK_BUDGET_S = 30


async def _run_agent(agent: Agent, deadline_bound: bool) -> None:
    timeline.AGENT.set(agent.name)          # every span this agent (and the tasks it starts) records carries its name
    try:
        if deadline_bound and agent.phase not in (Phase.VERIFY, Phase.COMPUTE):
            await _until_collect_ends(agent.ctx, agent.run())
            return
        budget = agent.ctx.time_left() if deadline_bound else agent.ctx.seconds_left() - FINAL_MARGIN_S
        if agent.phase in (Phase.VERIFY, Phase.COMPUTE):
            budget = max(budget, QUICK_BUDGET_S)
        await asyncio.wait_for(agent.run(), timeout=max(1.0, budget))
    except asyncio.TimeoutError:
        agent.ctx.board.error(agent.name, "timed out")
        log.warning("%s timed out", agent.name)
    except Exception as error:
        agent.ctx.board.error(agent.name, f"{type(error).__name__}: {error}")
        log.exception("%s failed", agent.name)


async def _until_collect_ends(ctx, coro) -> None:
    """Run `coro` until it ends or the collect time is used up. The cutoff follows the live submission reserve (it
    moves with the measured pace), so it is re-checked every second rather than fixed when the phase starts."""
    task = asyncio.ensure_future(coro)
    try:
        while not task.done():
            left = ctx.time_left()
            if left <= 0:
                task.cancel()
                await asyncio.gather(task, return_exceptions=True)
                raise asyncio.TimeoutError
            await asyncio.wait({task}, timeout=min(1.0, max(0.05, left)))
        task.result()
    finally:
        if not task.done():
            task.cancel()
            await asyncio.gather(task, return_exceptions=True)


def _position_keys(tender: dict) -> dict:
    try:
        from agents.compute_bid import position_keys
        return {str(p.get("position")): position_keys(tender.get("clarifications") or [], str(p.get("position")))["keys"]

def board_summary(board: Blackboard) -> dict:

    r = board.results

            "positions": len((r.get("tender") or {}).get("positions") or []),
            "qa": len((r.get("tender") or {}).get("clarifications") or []),
            "requirements": sorted(r.get("requirements") or {}),
            "materials": {p: (m.get("material"), m.get("reason")) for p, m in (r.get("materials") or {}).items()},
            "erp": {"materials": len(erp.get("materials") or {}), "conditions": len(erp.get("conditions") or []),

            "discount": r.get("discount"),

            # meet for packaging, commitments, setup pools, project bonus and condition groups
            "mail_topics": {t: sorted(v) if isinstance(v, dict) else v for t, v in (r.get("mail") or {}).items()},
            "position_keys": _position_keys(r.get("tender") or {}),
            "open_gaps": [g.get("id") for g in r.get("gaps") or []],
            "unresolved": (r.get("bid_draft") or {}).get("unresolved"),
            "tips": sum(len(v) for v in (r.get("tips") or {}).values()), "errors": len(board.errors)}


STALL_S = 45     # the event loop blocked this long: every thread's stack goes to stderr (diagnosis of frozen runs)


async def _heartbeat() -> None:
    """Re-arm the stall dump while the event loop runs; if one synchronous call blocks the loop, the dump fires."""
    try:
        while True:
            faulthandler.dump_traceback_later(STALL_S, repeat=True, file=sys.stderr)
            await asyncio.sleep(STALL_S / 3)

def progress_line(ctx) -> str:
    """One line per minute: clock, coverage of the draft bid, and where the last minute went."""
    tl = timeline.current()
    since = max(0.0, tl.now() - PROGRESS_EVERY_S)
    totals = tl.totals(since)
    cov = (ctx.board.get("bid_draft") or {}).get("coverage") or {}
    pages = "/".join(str(sum(1 for e in ctx.board.evidence if e.kind == f"{k}.page")) for k in ("tender", "spec", "erp", "mail"))

    def t(cat):
        x = totals.get(cat) or {"s": 0, "n": 0}
        return f"{x['s']:.0f}s/{x['n']}"

            f"reserve {ctx.submit_reserve():.0f}s) pages t/s/e/m {pages} positions {cov.get('priced', 0)}/"
            f"{cov.get('positions', 0)} priced, {cov.get('complete', 0)} complete, {cov.get('unresolved', 0)} open deps"
            f" | last {PROGRESS_EVERY_S:.0f}s: steps {t('browse.step')} queue {t('model.queue')} calls "
            f"{t('model.call')} extract {t('extract')} waits {t('wait.dep')} recovery {t('recovery')} | "
            f"model calls {ctx.llm.calls}")


async def _progress(ctx) -> None:
    while True:

        except Exception as error:  # noqa: BLE001 - reporting must never fail a run

async def run_swarm(task: dict, playwright, scored: bool, env=os.environ):
    board = Blackboard()

        board = Blackboard.load(Path(preload))
    ctx = Context(task=task, board=board, llm=LLM(), pool=BrowserPool(playwright), scored=scored)
    tl = timeline.reset(ctx.monotonic_start)
    classes = select(discover(), None if scored else env.get("SWARM_ONLY"))
    from swarm.browser_agent import _CHECKED, _HUNG_AT, _MAIN_TABS, _OWNERS, _OPENERS
    from swarm import guard
    for state in (_MAIN_TABS, _OWNERS, _OPENERS, _CHECKED, _HUNG_AT):
        state.clear()

    guard._PENDING.clear()

            agents = [c(ctx) for c in classes if c.phase == phase]
            if not agents:
                continue
            bound = phase != Phase.SUBMIT
            if phase not in ALWAYS and ctx.time_left() <= 0:
                log.warning("skipping phase %s: out of time", phase.name)
                continue

            if phase == Phase.SUBMIT:
                timeline.mark("submit start", left=round(ctx.seconds_left()),
                              positions=len(((board.get("bid") or {}).get("answer") or {}).get("positions") or []))

            background = [asyncio.create_task(_run_agent(a, bound)) for a in agents if a.background]
            try:
                await asyncio.gather(*(_run_agent(a, bound) for a in agents if not a.background))
            finally:

                    running.cancel()
                await asyncio.gather(progress, *background, return_exceptions=True)
            if phase == Phase.COLLECT:

"""Base class for site scrapers: a model-driven browse of ONE site that streams Evidence onto the blackboard.

Subclass, set `role` ('tender' | 'spec' | 'erp' | 'mail') and `browser`, and write `goal()` (what the model should
find, in general terms derived from the brief; never scenario values). The site id for the role is resolved at run
time (datasets name their sites differently). Override `run()` for several browse passes; call `self.browse(goal)`.

When the scraper ends (done, failed or out of time) it sets results[f"done.{role}"] so analysts waiting on it start.
Independent jobs run at once with `browse_in_tabs` (one new tab each, closed when its job ends); `self.browse` works
in the browser's main tab.
"""
import asyncio

from swarm import timeline
from swarm.agent import Agent, Phase
from swarm.blackboard import Evidence
from swarm.browser_agent import Tab, browse
from swarm.extract import brief_intro
from swarm.sites import site_for

ANALYSIS_RESERVE_S = 75     # scrapers stop browsing this long before collecting ends (analysts need the time)
IDLE_STEPS = 10             # a collection browse that saved pages, then saves nothing for this many steps, ends


class SiteScraper(Agent):
    phase = Phase.COLLECT
    role: str = ""
    site_id: str = ""
    max_steps: int = 40
    hints: str = ""

    def goal(self) -> str:
        raise NotImplementedError

    def login_text(self) -> str:
        site = self.ctx.site(self.site_id)
        creds = site.get("credentials") or {}
        return f"Site ({self.role}): {site['url']}\nLogin: username {creds.get('username')!r}, password {creds.get('password')!r}"

    def task_text(self) -> str:
        facts = self.ctx.board.get("brief") or {}
        known = {k: facts.get(k) for k in ("tender_reference", "tender_title", "buyer", "scenario_date", "bidder_company")
                 if facts.get(k)}
        return f"CONTEXT:\n{brief_intro(self.ctx.brief)}\nKey facts: {known}" if known else \
            f"CONTEXT:\n{brief_intro(self.ctx.brief)}"

    async def post(self, rec: dict) -> None:
        kind = f"{self.role}.page" if rec["kind"] == "page" else rec["kind"]
        await self.ctx.board.post(Evidence(kind=kind, site=self.site_id, data=rec["data"], source=rec["source"],
                                           author=self.name, note=rec["note"]))
        if kind.endswith(".page"):
            timeline.mark(f"first {kind}")

    def stop_extra(self, kwargs: dict) -> float:
        return kwargs.get("stop_extra", ANALYSIS_RESERVE_S)

    async def browse(self, job: str, *, browser: int | None = None, max_steps: int | None = None, **kwargs) -> dict:
        prompt = "\n\n".join([self.login_text(), self.task_text(), f"YOUR JOB:\n{job}"])
        # stop browsing early enough for the analysts to turn the last pages into results before collecting ends
        kwargs.setdefault("stop_extra", ANALYSIS_RESERVE_S)
        kwargs.setdefault("idle_steps", IDLE_STEPS)
        out = await browse(self.ctx, prompt, browser=self.browser if browser is None else browser, site_id=self.site_id,
                           on_record=self.post, max_steps=max_steps or self.max_steps, hints=self.hints,
                           author=kwargs.pop("author", self.name), **kwargs)
        self.log.info("browse done in %d steps, %d records: %s", out["steps"], len(out["records"]), out["summary"][:300])
        return out

    def time_for_retry(self, kwargs: dict, need: float = 120) -> bool:
        stop = kwargs["stop_reserve"] if kwargs.get("stop_reserve") is not None else self.ctx.stop_at(self.stop_extra(kwargs))
        return self.ctx.seconds_left() - stop >= need

    async def browse_until_done(self, job: str, attempts: int = 3, **kwargs) -> dict:
        """browse(); if the agent stopped without finishing (errors, step limit, a crashed browser agent), start again
        with a note on what is already saved, while time allows. Saved pages are never collected twice."""
        out = {"summary": "", "done": False}
        records = []
        for attempt in range(attempts):
            note = ""
            if attempt:
                saved = sorted({e.data.get("topic") for e in self.ctx.board.query(f"{self.role}.page")} - {None})
                note = (f"\n\nNOTE: previous attempt stopped early ({out['summary'][:300]!r}). Already saved: "
                        f"{saved or 'nothing'}. Do only what is missing.")
                timeline.count("browse.retries")
            try:
                out = await self.browse(job + note, **kwargs)
            except Exception as error:  # noqa: BLE001 - a failed connection is one failed attempt, not the end
                self.ctx.board.error(self.name, f"browse attempt {attempt + 1}: {type(error).__name__}: {error}")
                self.log.warning("browse attempt %d failed: %s", attempt + 1, error)
                out = {"summary": f"failed: {type(error).__name__}", "done": False, "records": [], "steps": 0}
            records.extend(out.get("records") or [])
            rejected = self.ctx.shared.get("site_invalidations", {}).get(self.role, set())
            if self.site_id in rejected:
                self.site_id = await site_for(self.ctx, self.role)
                # A reused tab may still show the old application; runtime model navigates the newly assigned URL.
                job += "\nThe prior site assignment was contradicted. Navigate to the newly assigned site URL in Login."
                out["done"] = False
            if out["done"] or not self.time_for_retry(kwargs):
                break
        return {**out, "records": records}

    async def browse_in_tabs(self, jobs: list[str], *, browser: int | None = None, attempts: int = 2,
                             **kwargs) -> list[dict]:
        """Run `jobs` at once, each in a new tab of this scraper's browser (the tabs share its login cookies). Each tab
        is closed as soon as its job ends, so no tab sits idle. A failed job returns {"summary": error, "done": False}."""
        async def one(job: str) -> dict:
            tab = Tab(self.browser if browser is None else browser)
            try:
                return await self.browse_until_done(job, attempts=attempts, tab=tab, **kwargs)
            except Exception as error:
                self.ctx.board.error(self.name, f"tab job failed: {error}")
                return {"summary": str(error), "done": False}
            finally:
                await tab.close()
        return list(await asyncio.gather(*(one(job) for job in jobs)))

    async def wait_brief(self, timeout: float = 180) -> dict:
        try:
            return await self.ctx.board.wait_for(key="brief", timeout=timeout) or {}
        except TimeoutError:
            return {}

    def required(self) -> list[tuple[tuple[str, ...], str]]:
        """Pages that must be saved, as (topic keywords, focused job). After the main browse, a focused browse runs
        for each one whose keywords appear in no saved topic. Override per scraper."""
        return []

    def saved_topics(self) -> str:
        return " | ".join(str(e.data.get("topic", "")).lower() for e in self.ctx.board.query(f"{self.role}.page"))

    async def run(self) -> None:
        try:
            self.site_id = self.site_id or await site_for(self.ctx, self.role)
            out = await self.browse_until_done(self.goal())   # the brief's intro already names the tender: start at once
            await self.ctx.board.set(f"{self.name}.summary", out["summary"])
            await self.required_pass()
        finally:
            await self.ctx.board.set(f"done.{self.role}", True)

    async def required_pass(self) -> None:
        for keywords, job in self.required():
            if self.ctx.time_left() > 90 and not any(k in self.saved_topics() for k in keywords):
                self.log.warning("nothing saved for %s: focused browse", keywords)
                await self.browse_until_done(job, attempts=1, max_steps=15)


def scraper_class(role: str) -> type[SiteScraper] | None:
    from swarm.agent import REGISTRY
    return next((c for c in REGISTRY if isinstance(c, type) and issubclass(c, SiteScraper) and c.role == role), None)


async def run_job(ctx, role: str, job: str, *, max_steps: int = 16, **kwargs) -> dict:
    """One follow-up job on the site of `role`, run by that role's scraper setup (login, hints, browser): in the
    browser's main tab when it is free (logged in already), else in a new tab. For agents/coordinate.py."""
    cls = scraper_class(role)
    if cls is None:
        raise KeyError(f"no scraper for role {role!r}")
    scraper = cls(ctx)
    scraper.name = f"{cls.__name__}.followup"
    scraper.site_id = await site_for(ctx, role)
    main = ctx.lock(f"main_tab.{scraper.browser}")
    if not main.locked():
        async with main:
            return await scraper.browse_until_done(job, attempts=1, max_steps=max_steps, **kwargs)
    return (await scraper.browse_in_tabs([job], attempts=1, max_steps=max_steps, **kwargs))[0]

        kwargs.setdefault("response_format", {"type": "json_object"})    # Qwen then always answers with JSON

"""Where a run's time goes: spans (useful work, waits, recovery, model queue, extraction) and milestones.

The platform keeps only the tail of a run's log, so the timeline logs compact lines: a progress line per minute during
collection, one line per milestone, and a short report at the end (category totals, slowest spans, repeated work, time
to first usable bid / complete positions / accepted submission). Locally the full span list is written to `.swarm/`.

    with timeline.span("wait.dep", "requirements"):      # who: the running agent (context variable)
        ...
    timeline.mark("first usable bid", positions=2)       # milestone, first occurrence only
    timeline.count("reads.repeat")                        # repeated work

Categories:
  browse.step     one browsing step (model reply + action + page state): the useful browser work
  model.queue     waiting for a free model slot (our concurrency limit)
  model.call      model latency (analysis, planning, guard; browsing steps contain their own call)
  extract         saved page -> facts (model extraction)
  wait.dep        an agent waiting for an upstream result
  recovery        browser checks, hung tabs, reattaching, retries after failures
  guard           popup sweeps before a step
  browse.failed   whole browses that ended without success (repeated later)
"""
import contextlib
import contextvars
import json
import logging
import time
from collections import defaultdict
from pathlib import Path

log = logging.getLogger("timeline")

AGENT: contextvars.ContextVar[str] = contextvars.ContextVar("swarm_agent", default="-")


def who() -> str:
    return AGENT.get()


class Timeline:
    def __init__(self, start: float | None = None):
        self.start = time.monotonic() if start is None else start
        self.spans: list[tuple[str, str, str, float, float]] = []   # category, agent, label, start, end (run clock)
        self.milestones: dict[str, tuple[float, dict]] = {}
        self.counters: dict[str, int] = defaultdict(int)
        self.max_spans = 20_000

    def now(self) -> float:
        return time.monotonic() - self.start

    def add(self, category: str, label: str = "", start: float | None = None, end: float | None = None,
            agent: str | None = None) -> None:
        end = self.now() if end is None else end
        if len(self.spans) < self.max_spans:
            self.spans.append((category, agent or who(), str(label)[:80], end if start is None else start, end))

    @contextlib.contextmanager
    def span(self, category: str, label: str = "", agent: str | None = None):
        start = self.now()
        try:
            yield
        finally:
            self.add(category, label, start, self.now(), agent)

    def mark(self, name: str, **info) -> bool:
        """Record a milestone once (its first time); True if this call recorded it."""
        if name in self.milestones:
            return False
        self.milestones[name] = (self.now(), info)
        log.info("milestone %s at %s %s", name, clock(self.now()), json.dumps(info, default=str)[:200] if info else "")
        return True

    def count(self, name: str, n: int = 1) -> None:
        self.counters[name] += n

    # ---- reports --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    def totals(self, since: float = 0.0) -> dict[str, dict]:
        out: dict[str, dict] = {}
        for cat, _, _, s, e in self.spans:
            if e < since:
                continue
            t = out.setdefault(cat, {"s": 0.0, "n": 0})
            t["s"] += e - max(s, since)
            t["n"] += 1
        return {k: {"s": round(v["s"], 1), "n": v["n"]} for k, v in sorted(out.items(), key=lambda kv: -kv[1]["s"])}

    def by_agent(self, category: str) -> dict[str, float]:
        out: dict[str, float] = defaultdict(float)
        for cat, agent, _, s, e in self.spans:
            if cat == category:
                out[agent] += e - s
        return {k: round(v, 1) for k, v in sorted(out.items(), key=lambda kv: -kv[1])}

    def busy(self, category: str, agent: str | None = None) -> float:
        """Wall-clock seconds covered by at least one span of `category` (overlaps counted once)."""
        intervals = sorted((s, e) for cat, a, _, s, e in self.spans if cat == category and (agent is None or a == agent))
        total, cur_s, cur_e = 0.0, None, None
        for s, e in intervals:
            if cur_e is None or s > cur_e:
                if cur_e is not None:
                    total += cur_e - cur_s
                cur_s, cur_e = s, e
            else:
                cur_e = max(cur_e, e)
        if cur_e is not None:
            total += cur_e - cur_s
        return round(total, 1)

    def median_step(self, last: int = 40, default: float = 14.0) -> float:
        """Median duration of the latest browsing steps: the run's measured pace (model + browser)."""
        steps = [e - s for cat, _, _, s, e in self.spans if cat == "browse.step"][-last:]
        if len(steps) < 5:
            return default
        steps.sort()
        return steps[len(steps) // 2]

    def slowest(self, n: int = 8, categories=None) -> list[tuple]:
        spans = [x for x in self.spans if categories is None or x[0] in categories]
        return [(cat, agent, label, round(e - s, 1), clock(s)) for cat, agent, label, s, e in
                sorted(spans, key=lambda x: x[3] - x[4])[:n]]

    def report(self) -> dict:
        m = {k: round(v[0], 1) for k, v in sorted(self.milestones.items(), key=lambda kv: kv[1][0])}
        return {"elapsed": round(self.now(), 1), "milestones": m, "totals": self.totals(),
                "wall": {c: self.busy(c) for c in ("browse.step", "model.queue", "extract", "wait.dep", "recovery")},
                "steps_by_agent": self.by_agent("browse.step"), "waits_by_agent": self.by_agent("wait.dep"),
                "recovery_by_agent": self.by_agent("recovery"), "counters": dict(self.counters),
                "slowest": self.slowest(8, ("browse.step", "model.call", "extract", "wait.dep", "recovery",
                                           "model.queue", "browse.failed"))}

    def log_report(self) -> None:
        """A few compact lines (the platform keeps only the log's tail)."""
        r = self.report()
        log.info("TIMELINE milestones %s", json.dumps(r["milestones"]))
        log.info("TIMELINE totals %s wall %s", json.dumps(r["totals"]), json.dumps(r["wall"]))
        log.info("TIMELINE agents steps %s waits %s recovery %s", json.dumps(r["steps_by_agent"]),
                 json.dumps(r["waits_by_agent"]), json.dumps(r["recovery_by_agent"]))
        log.info("TIMELINE counters %s", json.dumps(r["counters"]))
        log.info("TIMELINE slowest %s", json.dumps(r["slowest"], default=str))

    def dump(self, path: Path) -> None:
        path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        path.write_text(json.dumps({"report": self.report(), "spans": self.spans,
                                    "milestones": {k: [round(t, 2), i] for k, (t, i) in self.milestones.items()}},
                                   default=str), encoding="utf-8")


def clock(seconds: float) -> str:
    seconds = max(0, int(seconds))
    return f"{seconds // 60:02d}:{seconds % 60:02d}"


_CURRENT = Timeline()


def current() -> Timeline:
    return _CURRENT


def reset(start: float | None = None) -> Timeline:
    global _CURRENT
    _CURRENT = Timeline(start)
    return _CURRENT


def span(category: str, label: str = "", agent: str | None = None):
    return _CURRENT.span(category, label, agent)


def add(category: str, label: str = "", start: float | None = None, end: float | None = None,
        agent: str | None = None) -> None:
    _CURRENT.add(category, label, start, end, agent)


def mark(name: str, **info) -> bool:
    return _CURRENT.mark(name, **info)


def count(name: str, n: int = 1) -> None:
    _CURRENT.count(name, n)


def now() -> float:
    return _CURRENT.now()

ALWAYS = (Phase.VERIFY, Phase.COMPUTE, Phase.SUBMIT)
QUICK_BUDGET_S = 30


async def _run_agent(agent: Agent, deadline_bound: bool) -> None:
    timeline.AGENT.set(agent.name)          # every span this agent (and the tasks it starts) records carries its name
    try:
        if deadline_bound and agent.phase not in (Phase.VERIFY, Phase.COMPUTE):
            await _until_collect_ends(agent.ctx, agent.run())
            return
        budget = agent.ctx.time_left() if deadline_bound else agent.ctx.seconds_left() - FINAL_MARGIN_S
        if agent.phase in (Phase.VERIFY, Phase.COMPUTE):
            budget = max(budget, QUICK_BUDGET_S)
        await asyncio.wait_for(agent.run(), timeout=max(1.0, budget))
    except asyncio.TimeoutError:
        agent.ctx.board.error(agent.name, "timed out")
        log.warning("%s timed out", agent.name)
    except Exception as error:
        agent.ctx.board.error(agent.name, f"{type(error).__name__}: {error}")
        log.exception("%s failed", agent.name)


async def _until_collect_ends(ctx, coro) -> None:
    """Run `coro` until it ends or the collect time is used up. The cutoff follows the live submission reserve (it
    moves with the measured pace), so it is re-checked every second rather than fixed when the phase starts."""
    task = asyncio.ensure_future(coro)
    try:
        while not task.done():
            left = ctx.time_left()
            if left <= 0:
                task.cancel()
                await asyncio.gather(task, return_exceptions=True)
                raise asyncio.TimeoutError
            await asyncio.wait({task}, timeout=min(1.0, max(0.05, left)))
        task.result()
    finally:
        if not task.done():
            task.cancel()
            await asyncio.gather(task, return_exceptions=True)

"""Runs the registered agents phase by phase. Agents of one phase run concurrently; a failing agent never stops others.

Time: non-SUBMIT phases are cut off when the useful time is gone (ctx.time_left() <= 0), then SUBMIT always runs.
Local dev: SWARM_ONLY=a,b runs only those agents; SWARM_BOARD_IN=.swarm/board.json preloads a saved board (ignored
in scored runs). The board is dumped to .swarm/board.json after every phase.
"""
import asyncio
import importlib
import json
import logging
import os
import pkgutil
import time
from pathlib import Path

import agents as agents_pkg
from swarm.agent import REGISTRY, Agent, Phase
from swarm.blackboard import Blackboard
from swarm.browser_pool import BrowserPool
from swarm.context import Context
from swarm.llm import LLM

log = logging.getLogger("swarm")
BOARD_DUMP = Path(".swarm/board.json")
RUN_STATS = Path(".swarm/run_stats.json")
TIMINGS: dict[str, float] = {}
# Qwen's published prices per million tokens (input, cached input, output): the simulated cost the ranking uses
PRICE = {"prompt": 0.15, "cached": 0.016, "completion": 0.47}


def run_report(ctx, phases: dict) -> dict:
    """Time and tokens per phase, agent and browser: one JSON object, logged and (locally) saved."""
    board = ctx.board
    browse = {k.split(".", 1)[1]: v for k, v in board.results.items() if k.startswith("stats.") and isinstance(v, dict)}
    prompt = ctx.llm.tokens["prompt"] + sum(v.get("prompt_tokens") or 0 for v in browse.values())
    cached = sum(v.get("cached_tokens") or 0 for v in browse.values())
    completion = ctx.llm.tokens["completion"] + sum(v.get("completion_tokens") or 0 for v in browse.values())
    kinds: dict[str, int] = {}
    for e in board.evidence:
        kinds[e.kind] = kinds.get(e.kind, 0) + 1
    for v in browse.values():
        steps = v.pop("step_seconds", None) or []
        if steps:
            v["step_seconds_mean"] = round(sum(steps) / len(steps), 1)
            v["step_seconds_max"] = max(steps)
    return {
        "elapsed": round(ctx.elapsed(), 1), "phases": phases, "agents": TIMINGS, "browse": browse,
        "direct_llm": {"calls": ctx.llm.calls, **ctx.llm.tokens},
        "tokens": {"prompt": prompt, "cached": cached, "completion": completion},
        "cost_usd": round(((prompt - cached) * PRICE["prompt"] + cached * PRICE["cached"]
                           + completion * PRICE["completion"]) / 1e6, 4),
        "evidence": kinds, "errors": board.errors,
        "submission": board.get("submission"),
    }


def discover() -> list[type[Agent]]:
    """Import every module in agents/ so its @register decorators run."""
    for mod in pkgutil.iter_modules(agents_pkg.__path__):
        importlib.import_module(f"agents.{mod.name}")
    return list(REGISTRY)


def select(classes: list[type[Agent]], only: str | None) -> list[type[Agent]]:
    if not only:
        return classes
    wanted = {n.strip() for n in only.split(",") if n.strip()}
    return [c for c in classes if (c.name or c.__name__) in wanted or c.__name__ in wanted]


async def _run_agent(agent: Agent, deadline_bound: bool) -> None:
    started = time.time()
    try:
        budget = agent.ctx.time_left() if deadline_bound else agent.ctx.seconds_left() - 60
        await asyncio.wait_for(agent.run(), timeout=max(1.0, budget))
    except asyncio.TimeoutError:
        agent.ctx.board.error(agent.name, "timed out")
        log.warning("%s timed out", agent.name)
    except Exception as error:
        agent.ctx.board.error(agent.name, f"{type(error).__name__}: {error}")
        log.exception("%s failed", agent.name)
    finally:
        TIMINGS[agent.name] = round(time.time() - started, 1)
        for key in agent.writes:
            if agent.ctx.board.get(key) is None:
                await agent.ctx.board.set(key, {})


async def run_swarm(task: dict, playwright, scored: bool, env=os.environ):
    board = Blackboard()
    preload = env.get("SWARM_BOARD_IN")
    if preload and not scored:                       # never replay data in a scored run
        board = Blackboard.load(Path(preload))
    ctx = Context(task=task, board=board, llm=LLM(), pool=BrowserPool(playwright), scored=scored)
    classes = select(discover(), env.get("SWARM_ONLY"))
    log.info("agents: %s", [c.__name__ for c in classes])
    phases = {}
    for phase in Phase:
        agents = [c(ctx) for c in classes if c.phase == phase]
        if not agents:
            continue
        bound = phase != Phase.SUBMIT
        if bound and ctx.time_left() <= 0:
            log.warning("skipping phase %s: out of time", phase.name)
            continue
        log.info("phase %s: %s (%.0fs left)", phase.name, [a.name for a in agents], ctx.seconds_left())
        started = time.time()
        await asyncio.gather(*(_run_agent(a, bound) for a in agents))
        phases[phase.name] = round(time.time() - started, 1)
        if not scored:
            board.dump(BOARD_DUMP)
    log.info("model calls: %d tokens: %s errors: %d", ctx.llm.calls, ctx.llm.tokens, len(board.errors))
    report = run_report(ctx, phases)
    log.info("RUNSTATS %s", json.dumps(report, separators=(",", ":")))
    if not scored:
        RUN_STATS.write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=1))
    return board.get("answer")

Subclass, set `role` ('tender' | 'spec' | 'erp' | 'mail') and `browser`, and write `goal()` (what the model should

from swarm.agent import Agent, Phase

from swarm.sites import site_for

IDLE_STEPS = 10             # a collection browse that saved pages, then saves nothing for this many steps, ends

    site_id: str = ""
    max_steps: int = 40
    hints: str = ""

        raise NotImplementedError

        site = self.ctx.site(self.site_id)
        creds = site.get("credentials") or {}
        return f"Site ({self.role}): {site['url']}\nLogin: username {creds.get('username')!r}, password {creds.get('password')!r}"

    def task_text(self) -> str:
        facts = self.ctx.board.get("brief") or {}
        known = {k: facts.get(k) for k in ("tender_reference", "tender_title", "buyer", "scenario_date", "bidder_company")
                 if facts.get(k)}
        return f"CONTEXT:\n{brief_intro(self.ctx.brief)}\nKey facts: {known}" if known else \
            f"CONTEXT:\n{brief_intro(self.ctx.brief)}"

    async def post(self, rec: dict) -> None:
        kind = f"{self.role}.page" if rec["kind"] == "page" else rec["kind"]
        await self.ctx.board.post(Evidence(kind=kind, site=self.site_id, data=rec["data"], source=rec["source"],
                                           author=self.name, note=rec["note"]))
        if kind.endswith(".page"):
            timeline.mark(f"first {kind}")

    def stop_extra(self, kwargs: dict) -> float:
        return kwargs.get("stop_extra", ANALYSIS_RESERVE_S)

    async def browse(self, job: str, *, browser: int | None = None, max_steps: int | None = None, **kwargs) -> dict:
        prompt = "\n\n".join([self.login_text(), self.task_text(), f"YOUR JOB:\n{job}"])

        kwargs.setdefault("stop_extra", ANALYSIS_RESERVE_S)
        kwargs.setdefault("idle_steps", IDLE_STEPS)
        out = await browse(self.ctx, prompt, browser=self.browser if browser is None else browser, site_id=self.site_id,
                           on_record=self.post, max_steps=max_steps or self.max_steps, hints=self.hints,
                           author=kwargs.pop("author", self.name), **kwargs)

        return []

        return " | ".join(str(e.data.get("topic", "")).lower() for e in self.ctx.board.query(f"{self.role}.page"))

    from swarm.agent import REGISTRY
    return next((c for c in REGISTRY if isinstance(c, type) and issubclass(c, SiteScraper) and c.role == role), None)


async def run_job(ctx, role: str, job: str, *, max_steps: int = 16, **kwargs) -> dict:
    """One follow-up job on the site of `role`, run by that role's scraper setup (login, hints, browser): in the
    browser's main tab when it is free (logged in already), else in a new tab. For agents/coordinate.py."""
    cls = scraper_class(role)
    if cls is None:
        raise KeyError(f"no scraper for role {role!r}")
    scraper = cls(ctx)
    scraper.name = f"{cls.__name__}.followup"
    scraper.site_id = await site_for(ctx, role)
    main = ctx.lock(f"main_tab.{scraper.browser}")
    if not main.locked():
        async with main:
            return await scraper.browse_until_done(job, attempts=1, max_steps=max_steps, **kwargs)
    return (await scraper.browse_in_tabs([job], attempts=1, max_steps=max_steps, **kwargs))[0]
